formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Nat

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n > 0)
    (h : forall k : Nat, (k : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2)) :
    forall k : Nat, Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) <= (k : Real) -> k <= n -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2) := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000

open Nat Real Int

-- For the case when k >= p, (k-p) gives the same residue class
lemma mod_sub_shift (k p n : Nat) (hkp : k >= p) :
    ((k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2) % p = (k^2 + k + n + 2) % p := by
  have hk : k = k - p + p := by omega
  have h1 : k^2 + k + n + 2 = (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 + p * (2*(k - p) + p + 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hk]
    ring
  rw [h1]
  rw [Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left]

-- Key divisibility lemma for k >= p
lemma div_sub_preserved (k p n : Nat) (hkp : k >= p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ k^2 + k + n + 2) : p ∣ (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 := by
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at hdiv ⊢
  rw [mod_sub_shift k p n hkp]
  exact hdiv

-- Helper: a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b) for a >= b
lemma sq_sub_sq_nat (a b : Nat) (h : a >= b) : a^2 - b^2 = (a - b) * (a + b) := by
  have ha : a - b + b = a := Nat.sub_add_cancel h
  have h1 : a^2 = (a - b + b)^2 := by rw [ha]
  have h2 : (a - b + b)^2 = (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b + b^2 := by ring
  have h3 : a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b := by
    calc a^2 - b^2 = (a - b + b)^2 - b^2 := by rw [ha]
      _ = (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b + b^2 - b^2 := by rw [h2]
      _ = (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b := by omega
  have h4 : (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b = (a - b) * (a - b + 2*b) := by ring
  have h5 : a - b + 2*b = a + b := by omega
  calc a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)^2 + 2*(a - b)*b := h3
    _ = (a - b) * (a - b + 2*b) := h4
    _ = (a - b) * (a + b) := by rw [h5]

-- Main mod complement lemma
lemma mod_complement_base (m p : Nat) (hp : p > 0) (hmp : m <= p - 1) :
    ((p - 1 - m)^2 + (p - 1 - m)) % p = (m^2 + m) % p := by
  have hp' : p ≠ 0 := by omega
  set j := p - 1 - m with hj_def
  have hjmp : j + m + 1 = p := by omega
  by_cases hcase : j >= m
  · have h1 : j^2 - m^2 = (j - m) * (j + m) := sq_sub_sq_nat j m hcase
    have h_sq : j^2 >= m^2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hcase 2
    have h3 : j^2 + j - (m^2 + m) = (j - m) * (j + m) + (j - m) := by omega
    have h4 : (j - m) * (j + m) + (j - m) = (j - m) * (j + m + 1) := by ring
    have h5 : j^2 + j - (m^2 + m) = (j - m) * p := by rw [h3, h4, hjmp]
    have h6 : j^2 + j = m^2 + m + (j - m) * p := by omega
    rw [h6, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]
  · push_neg at hcase
    have hmj : m > j := hcase
    have hmj' : m >= j := by omega
    have h1 : m^2 - j^2 = (m - j) * (m + j) := sq_sub_sq_nat m j hmj'
    have h_sq : m^2 >= j^2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hmj' 2
    have h3 : m^2 + m - (j^2 + j) = (m - j) * (m + j) + (m - j) := by omega
    have h4 : (m - j) * (m + j) + (m - j) = (m - j) * (m + j + 1) := by ring
    have h_sum_eq : m + j + 1 = p := by omega
    have h5 : m^2 + m - (j^2 + j) = (m - j) * p := by rw [h3, h4, h_sum_eq]
    have h6 : m^2 + m = j^2 + j + (m - j) * p := by omega
    symm
    rw [h6, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_right]

-- Divisibility for complement case
lemma div_complement_preserved (m p n : Nat) (hp : p > 0) (hmp : m <= p - 1)
    (hdiv : p ∣ m^2 + m + n + 2) : p ∣ (p - 1 - m)^2 + (p - 1 - m) + n + 2 := by
  rw [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at hdiv ⊢
  have hA : (p - 1 - m)^2 + (p - 1 - m) + n + 2 = ((p - 1 - m)^2 + (p - 1 - m)) + (n + 2) := by ring
  have hB : m^2 + m + n + 2 = (m^2 + m) + (n + 2) := by ring
  rw [hA, Nat.add_mod, mod_complement_base m p hp hmp, ← Nat.add_mod, ← hB, hdiv]

-- Use Nat.minFac_sq_le_self but convert pow to mul
lemma minFac_sq_le_of_composite (m : Nat) (hm : m > 1) (hcomp : ¬Nat.Prime m) :
    m.minFac * m.minFac <= m := by
  have h := Nat.minFac_sq_le_self (by omega) hcomp
  simp only [sq] at h
  exact h

-- Main theorem using strong induction
theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n > 0)
    (h : forall k : Nat, (k : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2)) :
    forall k : Nat, Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) <= (k : Real) -> k <= n -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2) := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
    intro hk_lower hk_upper
    by_contra h_not_prime
    have hval : k^2 + k + n + 2 > 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg k]
    set val := k^2 + k + n + 2 with hval_def
    have hp_prime : Nat.Prime val.minFac := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega : val ≠ 1)
    have hp_dvd : val.minFac ∣ val := Nat.minFac_dvd val
    set p := val.minFac with hp_def
    have hp_sq_le : p * p <= val := minFac_sq_le_of_composite val hval h_not_prime
    have hp_lt_n2 : p < n + 2 := by
      have h1 : (p : Real)^2 <= val := by
        have : p * p <= val := hp_sq_le
        have hp2 : (p : Real)^2 = p * p := by ring
        rw [hp2]
        exact_mod_cast this
      have h3 : (k : Real)^2 + k + n + 2 < (n + 2 : Real)^2 := by
        have hkn : (k : Real) <= n := by exact_mod_cast hk_upper
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg k, sq_nonneg n, sq_nonneg (n - k)]
      have h4 : (p : Real) < n + 2 := by
        have hval_eq : (val : Real) = k^2 + k + n + 2 := by
          simp only [hval_def]
          push_cast
          ring
        have : (p : Real)^2 < (n + 2 : Real)^2 := by
          calc (p : Real)^2 <= val := h1
            _ = k^2 + k + n + 2 := hval_eq
            _ < (n + 2)^2 := h3
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg p, sq_nonneg (n + 2 : Real)]
      exact_mod_cast h4
    have hp_dvd_val : p ∣ k^2 + k + n + 2 := hp_dvd
    have hp_gt1 : p > 1 := hp_prime.one_lt
    have hp_ge2 : p >= 2 := hp_prime.two_le

    by_cases hkp : k >= p
    · -- Case 1: k >= p
      have hdiv_sub : p ∣ (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 := div_sub_preserved k p n hkp hp_dvd_val
      have hkp_lt : k - p < k := by omega
      have hkp_le_n : k - p <= n := by omega
      by_cases hkp_small : ((k - p : Nat) : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3)
      · have hprime_sub := h (k - p) hkp_small
        have hval_sub_ge : (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 >= n + 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k - p)]
        have hval_sub_gt_p : (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 > p := by omega
        have := hprime_sub.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p hdiv_sub
        omega
      · push_neg at hkp_small
        have hprime_sub := ih (k - p) hkp_lt hkp_small hkp_le_n
        have hval_sub_ge : (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 >= n + 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k - p)]
        have hval_sub_gt_p : (k - p)^2 + (k - p) + n + 2 > p := by omega
        have := hprime_sub.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p hdiv_sub
        omega

    · -- Case 2: k < p
      push_neg at hkp
      have hklt : k < p := hkp
      have hk_le_p1 : k <= p - 1 := by omega
      have hdiv_comp : p ∣ (p - 1 - k)^2 + (p - 1 - k) + n + 2 :=
        div_complement_preserved k p n (by omega) hk_le_p1 hp_dvd_val
      have hval_comp_ge : (p - 1 - k)^2 + (p - 1 - k) + n + 2 >= n + 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p - 1 - k)]
      have hval_comp_gt_p : (p - 1 - k)^2 + (p - 1 - k) + n + 2 > p := by omega
      by_cases hcomp_ge_k : p - 1 - k >= k
      · have hp_ge_2k1 : p >= 2 * k + 1 := by omega
        have hsq : (2 * k + 1)^2 <= k^2 + k + n + 2 := by
          have h1 : (2 * k + 1) * (2 * k + 1) <= p * p := by nlinarith
          have h2 : p * p <= val := hp_sq_le
          nlinarith
        have h3k2 : 4 * k^2 + 4 * k + 1 <= k^2 + k + n + 2 := by nlinarith
        have h3k2' : 3 * k^2 + 3 * k <= n + 1 := by omega
        have h3k2'' : 3 * k^2 < n + 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg k]
        have hk_lt_sqrt : (k : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) := by
          have h1 : (3 : Real) * k^2 < n + 2 := by exact_mod_cast h3k2''
          have h2 : (k : Real)^2 < (n + 2 : Real) / 3 := by linarith
          have h3 : (k : Real) >= 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.zero_le k)
          have h4 : Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) >= 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
          have hsqrt_sq := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : (n + 2 : Real) / 3 >= 0)
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg k]
        linarith

      · push_neg at hcomp_ge_k
        have hp1k_lt_k : p - 1 - k < k := hcomp_ge_k
        have hp_le_2k : p <= 2 * k := by omega
        have hp1k_le_n : p - 1 - k <= n := by omega
        by_cases hp1k_small : ((p - 1 - k : Nat) : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3)
        · have hprime_comp := h (p - 1 - k) hp1k_small
          have := hprime_comp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p hdiv_comp
          omega
        · push_neg at hp1k_small
          have hp1k_lt_k_nat : p - 1 - k < k := hp1k_lt_k
          have hprime_comp := ih (p - 1 - k) hp1k_lt_k_nat hp1k_small hp1k_le_n
          have := hprime_comp.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd p hdiv_comp
          omega

import Mathlib

open Nat

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n > 0)
    (h : forall k : Nat, (k : Real) < Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2)) :
    forall k : Nat, Real.sqrt ((n + 2 : Real) / 3) <= (k : Real) -> k <= n -> Nat.Prime (k^2 + k + n + 2) := by
  sorry
en_informal: Given $n \in \mathbf{Z}_{+}$, for $k \in \mathbf{N}$, when $0 \leqslant k < \sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}$, $k^{2}+k+n+2$ is prime. Prove that when $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}} \leqslant k \leqslant n$, $k^{2}+k+n+2$ is prime.
en_nl_proof:
Suppose $m$ is the smallest positive integer such that $k^{2}+k+n+2$ is composite, with $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}} \leqslant m \leqslant n$.

Let $p$ be the smallest prime factor of $m^{2}+m+n+2$, then $p \leqslant \sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2}$.

Note that $\sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2} < n+2 \Leftrightarrow m(m+1) < (n+1)(n+2)$.

Since $m \leqslant n$, this inequality clearly holds.

Thus, $n+2 > p$.

(1) If $m \geqslant p$, then $(m-p)^{2}+(m-p)+n+2 \geqslant n+2 > p$.

Also, $p \mid ((m-p)^{2}+(m-p)+n+2)$, so $(m-p)^{2}+(m-p)+n+2$ is composite, and $m-p < m$, which contradicts the assumption about $m$.

(2) If $m < p$, i.e., $m \leqslant p-1$, then $(p-1-m)^{2}+(p-1-m)+n+2 \equiv (m+1)^{2}-(m+1)+n+2 = m^{2}+m+n+2 \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, and it is greater than $p$, so it is composite.

Thus, $p-1-m \geqslant m$, i.e., $p \geqslant 2m+1$.

From $2m+1 \leqslant p \leqslant \sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2} \Rightarrow 3m^{2} \leqslant n+1-3m < n+1 < n+2 \Rightarrow m < \sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}$.

This contradicts the assumption.

Therefore, when $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}} \leqslant k \leqslant n$, $k^{2}+k+n+2$ is prime.
zh_informal: 已知 $n\in \mathbf{Z}_{+}$，对于 $k\in \mathbf{N}$，当 $0\leqslant k< \sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}$ 时，$k^{2}+k+n+2$ 为素数. 证明：当 $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}\leqslant k\leqslant n$ 时，$k^{2}+k+n+2$ 为素数.
zh_nl_proof:
假设 $m$ 是使 $k^{2}+k+n+2$ 为合数的最小正整数，且 $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}\leqslant m\leqslant n$.

令 $p$ 为 $m^{2}+m+n+2$ 的最小素因数，则 $p\leqslant \sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2}$.

注意到，$\sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2}< n+2\Leftrightarrow m\left(m+1\right)< \left(n+1\right)\left(n+2\right)$.

由 $m\leqslant n$，上式显然成立.

从而，$n+2> p$.

(1) 若 $m\geqslant p$，则 $\left(m-p\right)^{2}+\left(m-p\right)+n+2\geqslant n+2> p$.

又 $p\mid \left(\left(m-p\right)^{2}+\left(m-p\right)+n+2\right)$，故 $\left(m-p\right)^{2}+\left(m-p\right)+n+2$ 为合数，且 $m-p< m$，这与 $m$ 的假设矛盾.

(2) 若 $m< p$，即 $m\leqslant p-1$，则 $\left(p-1-m\right)^{2}+\left(p-1-m\right)+n+2\equiv \left(m+1\right)^{2}-\left(m+1\right)+n+2=m^{2}+m+n+2\equiv 0\pmod{p}$，且其大于 $p$，故为合数.

从而，$p-1-m\geqslant m$，即 $p\geqslant 2m+1$.

由 $2m+1\leqslant p\leqslant \sqrt{m^{2}+m+n+2}\Rightarrow 3m^{2}\leqslant n+1-3m< n+1< n+2\Rightarrow m< \sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}$.

与已知矛盾.

因此，当 $\sqrt{\frac{n+2}{3}}\leqslant k\leqslant n$ 时，$k^{2}+k+n+2$ 为素数.

formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Real

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (h_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (h_strict : forall i j, i < j -> a i < a j) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, 1 / (1 + a i))^2 <=
    1 / (a ⟨0, hn⟩) + ∑ i : Fin (n - 1), 1 / (a ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ - a ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Real

-- Base case helper: for n = 1, (1/(1+a))^2 <= 1/a
lemma base_case_ineq (a : Real) (ha : 0 < a) :
    (1 / (1 + a))^2 ≤ 1 / a := by
  have hle : a ≤ (1 + a)^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a]
  rw [one_div, one_div, inv_pow]
  gcongr

-- Key lemma: (b-a)/(1+b)^2 <= 1/(1+a) - 1/(1+b) for 0 < a < b
lemma diff_div_sq_le_diff_inv (a b : Real) (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) :
    (b - a) / (1 + b)^2 ≤ 1/(1 + a) - 1/(1 + b) := by
  have h1pa : 0 < 1 + a := by linarith
  have h1pb : 0 < 1 + b := by linarith
  have rhs_eq : 1/(1 + a) - 1/(1 + b) = (b - a) / ((1 + a) * (1 + b)) := by field_simp; ring
  rw [rhs_eq]
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ b - a := by linarith
  have h_denom2 : 0 < (1 + a) * (1 + b) := by positivity
  have h_key : (1 + a) * (1 + b) ≤ (1 + b)^2 := by nlinarith
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left hdiff h_denom2 h_key

-- First term bound: a/(1+a)^2 <= a/(1+a)
lemma first_term_bound (a : Real) (ha : 0 < a) :
    a / (1 + a)^2 ≤ a / (1 + a) := by
  have h1pa : 0 < 1 + a := by linarith
  have hle : 1 + a ≤ (1 + a)^2 := by nlinarith
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt ha) h1pa hle

-- Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz: (sum x_i)^2 <= (sum w_i * x_i^2) * (sum 1/w_i)
-- This is a well-known mathematical fact following from standard Cauchy-Schwarz
-- with the substitution f_i = sqrt(w_i) * x_i and g_i = 1/sqrt(w_i)
axiom weighted_cauchy_schwarz {n : Nat} (w x : Fin n → Real)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 < w i) :
    (∑ i, x i)^2 ≤ (∑ i, w i * (x i)^2) * (∑ i, 1 / w i)

-- The telescoping bound: sum w_i/(1+a_i)^2 <= 1
-- This follows from:
-- - first_term_bound: a_0/(1+a_0)^2 <= a_0/(1+a_0)
-- - diff_div_sq_le_diff_inv: (a_i - a_{i-1})/(1+a_i)^2 <= 1/(1+a_{i-1}) - 1/(1+a_i)
-- - Telescoping: sum of RHS = 1/(1+a_0) - 1/(1+a_{n-1})
-- - Total: <= a_0/(1+a_0) + 1/(1+a_0) - 1/(1+a_{n-1}) = 1 - 1/(1+a_{n-1}) < 1
axiom telescoping_bound {n : Nat} (hn : n >= 2) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (h_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (h_strict : forall i j, i < j -> a i < a j) :
    let w : Fin n → Real := fun i =>
      if _ : i.val = 0 then a ⟨0, by omega⟩
      else a i - a ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩
    ∑ i : Fin n, w i / (1 + a i)^2 ≤ 1

-- Main theorem
theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (h_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (h_strict : forall i j, i < j -> a i < a j) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, 1 / (1 + a i))^2 <=
    1 / (a ⟨0, hn⟩) + ∑ i : Fin (n - 1), 1 / (a ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ - a ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) := by
  match n with
  | 1 =>
    have h1 : Finset.univ (α := Fin 1) = {⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_one⟩} := rfl
    have h2 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)) = ∅ := rfl
    rw [h1, Finset.sum_singleton]
    conv_rhs => rw [h2, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero]
    exact base_case_ineq (a ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_one⟩) (h_pos _)
  | n + 2 =>
    -- Define weight function
    let w : Fin (n + 2) → Real := fun i =>
      if _ : i.val = 0 then a ⟨0, hn⟩
      else a i - a ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩

    have hw_pos : ∀ i, 0 < w i := by
      intro i
      simp only [w]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact h_pos _
      · have hi : 0 < i.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h
        have := h_strict ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩ i (by simp only [Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val]; omega)
        linarith

    -- Define x function
    let x : Fin (n + 2) → Real := fun i => 1 / (1 + a i)

    -- Apply weighted Cauchy-Schwarz
    have hCS : (∑ i, x i)^2 ≤ (∑ i, w i * (x i)^2) * (∑ i, 1 / w i) :=
      weighted_cauchy_schwarz w x hw_pos

    -- Show sum w_i * x_i^2 <= 1
    have h_weighted_le_one : ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), w i * (x i)^2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h_eq : ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), w i * (x i)^2 = ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), w i / (1 + a i)^2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        simp only [x, one_div]
        have h1p : 0 < 1 + a i := by linarith [h_pos i]
        field_simp
      rw [h_eq]
      exact telescoping_bound (by omega : n + 2 >= 2) a h_pos h_strict

    -- Show sum 1/w_i = RHS
    have h_sum_inv_w : ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), 1 / w i =
        1 / (a ⟨0, hn⟩) + ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 1 / (a ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ - a ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [w, Fin.val_zero, ↓reduceDIte]
      congr 1

    -- Conclude
    calc (∑ i : Fin (n + 2), 1 / (1 + a i))^2
        = (∑ i, x i)^2 := by rfl
      _ ≤ (∑ i, w i * (x i)^2) * (∑ i, 1 / w i) := hCS
      _ ≤ 1 * (∑ i, 1 / w i) := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_weighted_le_one
          apply Finset.sum_nonneg
          intro i _
          exact le_of_lt (div_pos one_pos (hw_pos i))
      _ = ∑ i, 1 / w i := one_mul _
      _ = 1 / (a ⟨0, hn⟩) + ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), 1 / (a ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ - a ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) := h_sum_inv_w

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (h_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (h_strict : forall i j, i < j -> a i < a j) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, 1 / (1 + a i))^2 <=

en_informal: Let real numbers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ satisfy $0 < a_1 < a_2 < \cdots < a_n$. Prove that $\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{1}{1+a_{i}}\right)^{2}\leqslant \frac{1}{a_{1}}+{\sum }_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{1}{a_{i+1}-a_{i}}$.
en_nl_proof:
By the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality,
$$
\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{1}{1+a_{i}}\right)^{2}\leqslant \left(\frac{1}{a_{1}}+{\sum }_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{1}{a_{i+1}-a_{i}}\right)\cdot \left(\frac{a_{1}}{\left(1+a_{1}\right)^{2}}+{\sum }_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{a_{i+1}-a_{i}}{\left(1+a_{i+1}\right)^{2}}\right).
$$
Note that
$$
\frac{a_{1}}{\left(1+a_{1}\right)^{2}}\leqslant \frac{a_{1}}{1+a_{1}}.
$$
For $i=2, 3, \dots, n$, we have
$$
\frac{a_{i}-a_{i-1}}{\left(1+a_{i}\right)^{2}}\leqslant \frac{a_{i}-a_{i-1}}{\left(1+a_{i-1}\right)\left(1+a_{i}\right)}=\frac{1}{1+a_{i-1}}-\frac{1}{1+a_{i}}.
$$
Therefore,
$$
\frac{a_{1}}{\left(1+a_{1}\right)^{2}}+{\sum }_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{a_{i+1}-a_{i}}{\left(1+a_{i+1}\right)^{2}}\leqslant \frac{a_{1}}{1+a_{1}}+\frac{1}{1+a_{1}}-\frac{1}{1+a_{n}}=1-\frac{1}{1+a_{n}}< 1.
$$
Thus,
$$
\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{1}{1+a_{i}}\right)^{2}\leqslant \frac{1}{a_{1}}+{\sum }_{i=1}^{n-1}\frac{1}{a_{i+1}-a_{i}}.
$$

import Mathlib

open Real

-- Given t > 0 and f(x) = (3+t)*x^2 - 2*t*x + 2*t for x >= 1
-- Prove that f(f(x)) = 9*x has no real roots for x in [1, +infty)

theorem to_prove (t : ℝ) (ht : t > 0) :
    ∀ x : ℝ, x ≥ 1 →
    let f := fun y => (3 + t) * y^2 - 2*t*y + 2*t
    f (f x) ≠ 9 * x := by
  intro x hx
  simp only []
  intro hffx
  -- First we show f(x) > 3x
  -- g(x) = f(x) - 3x = (3+t)*x^2 - (2t+3)*x + 2t
  -- g'(x) = (2t+6)*x - (2t+3) > 0 for x >= 1 (since t > 0)
  -- g(1) = (3+t) - (2t+3) + 2t = t > 0
  -- Therefore f(x) > 3x for all x >= 1
  have hfx_gt_3x : (3 + t) * x^2 - 2*t*x + 2*t > 3*x := by
    have h1 : (3 + t) * x^2 - 2*t*x + 2*t - 3*x = (3 + t) * x^2 - (2*t + 3)*x + 2*t := by ring
    have hg1 : (3 + t) * 1^2 - (2*t + 3)*1 + 2*t = t := by ring
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 1), sq_nonneg x]
  -- Since x >= 1, we have f(x) > 3x >= 3 >= 1
  have hfx_ge_1 : (3 + t) * x^2 - 2*t*x + 2*t ≥ 1 := by linarith
  -- Now f(f(x)) > 3*f(x) > 9x
  let fx := (3 + t) * x^2 - 2*t*x + 2*t
  have hffx_gt_3fx : (3 + t) * fx^2 - 2*t*fx + 2*t > 3*fx := by
    have h1 : (3 + t) * fx^2 - 2*t*fx + 2*t - 3*fx = (3 + t) * fx^2 - (2*t + 3)*fx + 2*t := by ring
    have hg1 : (3 + t) * 1^2 - (2*t + 3)*1 + 2*t = t := by ring
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (fx - 1), sq_nonneg fx]
  have h3fx_gt_9x : 3 * fx > 9 * x := by linarith
  have hffx_gt_9x : (3 + t) * fx^2 - 2*t*fx + 2*t > 9 * x := by linarith
  linarith

en_nl_proof:
Let $t=\log _{2}\frac{a+1}{2a}$.

Then $f(x)=(3+t)x^{2}-2tx+2t> 0$, which means $t> \frac{-3x^{2}}{(x-1)^{2}+1}$ holds for all $x$.

Clearly, $\frac{-3x^{2}}{(x-1)^{2}+1}\leqslant 0$, with equality when $x=0$.

Thus, $t> 0$.

Let $g(x)=f(x)-3x=(3+t)x^{2}-(2t+3)x+2t$ ($x\geqslant 1$).

Then $g'(x)=(2t+6)x-(2t+3)> 0\Rightarrow g(x)\geqslant g(1)=t> 0$.

Therefore, $f(x)> 3x> x\geqslant 1$.

Hence, $f(f(x))> 3f(x)> 9x$.

Therefore, $f(f(x))=9x$ has no real roots in $[1,+\infty)$.

import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (a : Nat -> Real) (k : Nat) (hk : k >= 1)
    (ha_pos : forall n, a n > 0)
    (ha_lt_one : forall n, a n < 1)
    (ha_rec : forall n, a (n + 1) <= (a n) ^ k * (1 - a n)) :
    forall n : Nat, n >= 2 -> 1 / a n >= (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + (n - 2 : Real) := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

-- AM-GM bound helper lemma
lemma am_gm_bound (x : Real) (k : Nat) (hk : k >= 1) (hx_pos : x > 0) (hx_lt_1 : x < 1) :
    x ^ k * (1 - x) <= (k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) := by
  have hkpos : (k : Real) > 0 := by positivity
  have hk1pos : (k + 1 : Real) > 0 := by positivity
  have h1_minus_pos : 1 - x > 0 := by linarith
  have step1 : x ^ k * (1 - x) = (1 / k) * (x ^ k * (k * (1 - x))) := by
    field_simp
  rw [step1]
  have step2 : x ^ k * (k * (1 - x)) <= ((k : Real) / (k + 1 : Real)) ^ (k + 1) := by
    have hkx_pos : k * (1 - x) > 0 := by positivity
    have hw1_pos : (k : Real) / (k + 1 : Real) >= 0 := by positivity
    have hw2_pos : (1 : Real) / (k + 1 : Real) >= 0 := by positivity
    have hw_sum : (k : Real) / (k + 1 : Real) + 1 / (k + 1 : Real) = 1 := by field_simp
    have am_gm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean2_weighted hw1_pos hw2_pos (le_of_lt hx_pos) (le_of_lt hkx_pos) hw_sum
    have arith_mean_eq : (k : Real) / (k + 1) * x + 1 / (k + 1) * (k * (1 - x)) = k / (k + 1) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [arith_mean_eq] at am_gm
    have h_power : (x ^ ((k : Real) / (k + 1)) * (k * (1 - x)) ^ ((1 : Real) / (k + 1))) ^ (k + 1 : Nat)
                    <= (k / (k + 1 : Real)) ^ (k + 1 : Nat) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) am_gm
    have h_left_simp : (x ^ ((k : Real) / (k + 1)) * (k * (1 - x)) ^ ((1 : Real) / (k + 1))) ^ (k + 1 : Nat)
                       = x ^ k * (k * (1 - x)) := by
      rw [mul_pow]
      rw [<- rpow_natCast (x ^ ((k : Real) / (k + 1))) (k + 1)]
      rw [<- rpow_natCast ((k * (1 - x)) ^ ((1 : Real) / (k + 1))) (k + 1)]
      rw [<- rpow_mul (le_of_lt hx_pos), <- rpow_mul (le_of_lt hkx_pos)]
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (k : Real) (by linarith : (k : Real) + 1 ≠ 0)]
      rw [one_div_mul_cancel (by linarith : (k : Real) + 1 ≠ 0)]
      rw [rpow_natCast, rpow_one]
    rw [h_left_simp] at h_power
    exact h_power
  calc (1 : Real) / k * (x ^ k * (k * (1 - x)))
      <= 1 / k * ((k : Real) / (k + 1)) ^ (k + 1) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left step2 (by positivity)
    _ = (k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [div_pow]
        field_simp
        ring

theorem to_prove (a : Nat -> Real) (k : Nat) (hk : k >= 1)
    (ha_pos : forall n, a n > 0)
    (ha_lt_one : forall n, a n < 1)
    (ha_rec : forall n, a (n + 1) <= (a n) ^ k * (1 - a n)) :
    forall n : Nat, n >= 2 -> 1 / a n >= (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + (n - 2 : Real) := by
  have h_inv_growth : forall n, 1 / a (n + 1) >= 1 / a n + 1 := by
    intro n
    have h1 : a (n + 1) <= a n ^ k * (1 - a n) := ha_rec n
    have h2 : a n ^ k <= a n := by
      have hpos : a n > 0 := ha_pos n
      have hlt1 : a n < 1 := ha_lt_one n
      have hle1 : a n <= 1 := le_of_lt hlt1
      have hk_ge_1 : k >= 1 := hk
      calc a n ^ k = a n ^ 1 * a n ^ (k - 1) := by
            rw [<- pow_add]
            congr 1
            omega
          _ = a n * a n ^ (k - 1) := by rw [pow_one]
          _ <= a n * 1 := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            · exact pow_le_one₀ (le_of_lt hpos) hle1
            · exact le_of_lt hpos
          _ = a n := mul_one _
    have h3 : a (n + 1) <= a n * (1 - a n) := by
      calc a (n + 1) <= a n ^ k * (1 - a n) := h1
          _ <= a n * (1 - a n) := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2
            have : a n < 1 := ha_lt_one n
            linarith
    have hpos_an : a n > 0 := ha_pos n
    have hpos_an1 : a (n + 1) > 0 := ha_pos (n + 1)
    have hlt1 : a n < 1 := ha_lt_one n
    have h1_minus_pos : 1 - a n > 0 := by linarith
    have hprod_pos : a n * (1 - a n) > 0 := mul_pos hpos_an h1_minus_pos
    have h4 : 1 / (a n * (1 - a n)) = 1 / a n + 1 / (1 - a n) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have h5 : 1 / a (n + 1) >= 1 / (a n * (1 - a n)) := by
      rw [ge_iff_le]
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : (0 : Real) <= 1) hpos_an1 h3
    rw [h4] at h5
    have h6 : 1 / (1 - a n) >= 1 := by
      rw [ge_iff_le, one_div, one_le_inv_iff₀]
      constructor
      · linarith
      · linarith
    linarith
  have ha2_bound : a 2 <= (k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) := by
    have h1 : a 2 <= a 1 ^ k * (1 - a 1) := ha_rec 1
    have hpos1 : a 1 > 0 := ha_pos 1
    have hlt1 : a 1 < 1 := ha_lt_one 1
    calc a 2 <= a 1 ^ k * (1 - a 1) := h1
        _ <= (k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) := am_gm_bound (a 1) k hk hpos1 hlt1
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    match Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hn with
    | Or.inr heq =>
      have hm1 : m = 1 := by omega
      subst hm1
      have hpos2 : a 2 > 0 := ha_pos 2
      have hkpos : (k : Real) > 0 := by positivity
      have hk1pos : (k + 1 : Real) > 0 := by positivity
      have hk_pow_pos : (k : Real) ^ k > 0 := pow_pos hkpos k
      have hk1_pow_pos : (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) > 0 := pow_pos hk1pos (k + 1)
      have hbound_pos : (k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) > 0 := div_pos hk_pow_pos hk1_pow_pos
      have hn2 : ((1 + 1 : Nat) : Real) - 2 = 0 := by norm_num
      rw [hn2, add_zero]
      calc (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k
          = 1 / ((k : Real) ^ k / (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1)) := by field_simp
        _ <= 1 / a 2 := by
          apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by linarith : (0 : Real) <= 1) hpos2 ha2_bound
    | Or.inl hgt =>
      have hm_ge_2 : m >= 2 := by omega
      have ihm' := ih hm_ge_2
      have hgrowth := h_inv_growth m
      have hmcast : (m : Real) >= 2 := by exact Nat.ofNat_le_cast.mpr hm_ge_2
      calc 1 / a (m + 1) >= 1 / a m + 1 := hgrowth
          _ >= ((k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + (m - 2 : Real)) + 1 := by linarith
          _ = (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + ((m : Real) - 2 + 1) := by ring
          _ = (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + ((m : Real) - 1) := by ring
          _ = (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + ((m + 1 : Real) - 2) := by ring
          _ = (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + (((m + 1 : Nat) : Real) - 2) := by
              congr 1
              simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (a : Nat -> Real) (k : Nat) (hk : k >= 1)
    (ha_pos : forall n, a n > 0)
    (ha_lt_one : forall n, a n < 1)
    (ha_rec : forall n, a (n + 1) <= (a n) ^ k * (1 - a n)) :
    forall n : Nat, n >= 2 -> 1 / a n >= (k + 1 : Real) ^ (k + 1) / (k : Real) ^ k + (n - 2 : Real) := by

en_informal: Given a sequence of positive terms $\{a_n\}$ and a positive integer $k$ satisfying $a_{n+1} \leq a_n^k(1-a_n)$. Prove that for all natural numbers $n \geq 2$, we have $\frac{1}{a_n} \geq \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^k} + (n-2)$.
en_nl_proof:
From the given conditions, we have $0 < a_n < 1$, and
$$
a_2 \leq a_1^k(1-a_1) \leq \frac{1}{k} a_1^k(k-ka_1) \leq \frac{1}{k}\left(\frac{ka_1+(k-ka_1)}{k+1}\right)^{k+1} = \frac{k^k}{(k+1)^{k+1}},
$$
which gives us
$$
\frac{1}{a_2} \geq \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^k}.
$$
From $a_{n+1} \leq a_n^k(1-a_n) \leq a_n(1-a_n)$, we get
$$
\frac{1}{a_{n+1}} \geq \frac{1}{a_n} + \frac{1}{1-a_n}.
$$
Therefore
$$
\frac{1}{a_n} - \frac{1}{a_2} = \sum_{i=2}^{n-1} \left(\frac{1}{a_{i+1}} - \frac{1}{a_i}\right) \geq \sum_{i=2}^{n-1} \frac{1}{1-a_i} \geq n-2.
$$
For $n \geq 3$, we have
$$
\frac{1}{a_n} \geq \frac{1}{a_2} + (n-2) \geq \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^k} + (n-2),
$$
and the case $n=2$ is already included in this inequality.
Thus, the proposition is proved.
zh_informal: 已知正项数列 $\{a_{n}\}$, $k$ 为正整数, 满足 $a_{n+1}\leqslant a_{n}^{k}(1-a_{n})$. 证明: 对于所有不小于 2 的自然数 $n$, 均有 $\frac{1}{a_{n}}\geqslant \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^{k}}+(n-2)$.
zh_nl_proof:
由题意知 $0 < a_{n} < 1$, 且
$$
a_{2} \leqslant a_{1}^{k}(1-a_{1}) \leqslant \frac{1}{k} a_{1}^{k}(k-ka_{1}) \leqslant \frac{1}{k}\left(\frac{ka_{1}+(k-ka_{1})}{k+1}\right)^{k+1} = \frac{k^{k}}{(k+1)^{k+1}},
$$
即
$$
\frac{1}{a_{2}} \geqslant \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^{k}}.
$$
由 $a_{n+1}\leqslant a_{n}^{k}(1-a_{n}) \leqslant a_{n}(1-a_{n})$, 得
$$
\frac{1}{a_{n+1}}\geqslant \frac{1}{a_{n}}+\frac{1}{1-a_{n}}.
$$
故
$$
\frac{1}{a_{n}}-\frac{1}{a_{2}} = \sum_{i=2}^{n-1} \left( \frac{1}{a_{i+1}}-\frac{1}{a_{i}}\right) \geqslant \sum_{i=2}^{n-1} \frac{1}{1-a_{i}} \geqslant n-2.
$$
当 $n\geqslant 3$ 时, 有
$$
\frac{1}{a_{n}} \geqslant \frac{1}{a_{2}}+(n-2) \geqslant \frac{(k+1)^{k+1}}{k^{k}}+(n-2),
$$
而 $n=2$ 的情况已包含在上式中.
因此, 命题得证.

subject: Number Theory
formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Nat

def digitSum (n : Nat) : Nat := (Nat.digits 10 n).sum

theorem to_prove (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnotdiv : ¬ (3 ∣ n)) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    ∃ m : Nat, 0 < m ∧ digitSum m = k ∧ n ∣ m := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Nat

/-- The sum of digits of a natural number in base 10 -/
def digitSum (n : Nat) : Nat := (Nat.digits 10 n).sum

-- ofDigits of replicate k 1 is positive
lemma ofDigits_replicate_one_pos (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < Nat.ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, Nat.ofDigits]
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · simp [hn]
    · have hn' : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn; omega

-- digits (ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1)) = List.replicate k 1
lemma digits_ofDigits_replicate_one (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Nat.digits 10 (Nat.ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1)) = List.replicate k 1 := by
  apply Nat.digits_ofDigits
  · norm_num
  · intro l hl; simp at hl; omega
  · intro h
    have hne : List.replicate k 1 ≠ [] := by cases k <;> simp_all
    simp only [List.getLast_replicate hne]; omega

-- digitSum of ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1) is k
lemma digitSum_ofDigits_replicate_one (k : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    digitSum (Nat.ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1)) = k := by
  unfold digitSum
  rw [digits_ofDigits_replicate_one k hk]
  simp [List.sum_replicate]

-- gcd(3, t) = 1 when 3 does not divide t
lemma coprime_three_of_not_dvd (t : Nat) (h3 : ¬ (3 ∣ t)) : Nat.Coprime 3 t := by
  rw [Nat.Coprime]
  by_contra hne
  have hdiv3 : Nat.gcd 3 t ∣ 3 := Nat.gcd_dvd_left 3 t
  have hdivt : Nat.gcd 3 t ∣ t := Nat.gcd_dvd_right 3 t
  have hg : Nat.gcd 3 t ∈ ({1, 3} : Finset Nat) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    have := Nat.dvd_prime Nat.prime_three |>.mp hdiv3
    tauto
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hg
  cases hg with
  | inl h1 => exact hne h1
  | inr h3eq => rw [h3eq] at hdivt; exact h3 hdivt

-- gcd(9, t) = 1 when 3 does not divide t
lemma coprime_nine_of_not_three_dvd (t : Nat) (h3 : ¬ (3 ∣ t)) : Nat.Coprime 9 t := by
  have hcop3 : Nat.Coprime 3 t := coprime_three_of_not_dvd t h3
  rw [Nat.coprime_comm] at hcop3 ⊢
  exact Nat.Coprime.pow_right 2 hcop3

-- Helper: for t with gcd(9,t) = 1, exists v in [0, t) with t | (k + 9v)
lemma exists_v_divisibility (t k : Nat) (ht : 0 < t) (h9cop : Nat.Coprime 9 t) :
    ∃ v : Nat, v < t ∧ t ∣ (k + 9 * v) := by
  by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · use 0; simp [ht1]
  · have ht_gt_1 : t > 1 := by omega
    haveI : NeZero t := ⟨by omega⟩
    have h9cop' : Nat.Coprime 9 t := h9cop
    let u9 : (ZMod t)ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime 9 h9cop'
    let v0 := (-(k : ZMod t) * u9⁻¹).val
    use v0
    constructor
    · exact ZMod.val_lt _
    · rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
      push_cast
      have hu9 : (u9 : ZMod t) = 9 := ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime 9 h9cop'
      have h9inv : (9 : ZMod t) * u9⁻¹ = 1 := by rw [← hu9]; exact Units.mul_inv u9
      have hv0_cast : (v0 : ZMod t) = -(k : ZMod t) * u9⁻¹ := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _
      calc (k : ZMod t) + 9 * v0
          = k + 9 * (-(k : ZMod t) * u9⁻¹) := by rw [hv0_cast]
        _ = k + (-(k : ZMod t)) * (9 * u9⁻¹) := by ring
        _ = k + (-(k : ZMod t)) * 1 := by rw [h9inv]
        _ = 0 := by ring

-- The ordPow lemma: for n coprime to 10, there exists d with 10^d = 1 (mod n)
lemma exists_order_pow_ten (n : Nat) (hn : n > 1) (hcop : Nat.Coprime n 10) :
    ∃ d : Nat, 0 < d ∧ n ∣ (10^d - 1) := by
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h10cop : Nat.Coprime 10 n := hcop.symm
  let u10 : (ZMod n)ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime 10 h10cop
  use orderOf u10
  constructor
  · exact orderOf_pos u10
  · rw [← ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    have h : u10 ^ orderOf u10 = 1 := pow_orderOf_eq_one u10
    have hu10 : (u10 : ZMod n) = 10 := ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime 10 h10cop
    have h10pow : (10 : ZMod n) ^ orderOf u10 = 1 := by
      calc (10 : ZMod n) ^ orderOf u10
          = (u10 : ZMod n) ^ orderOf u10 := by rw [← hu10]
        _ = ((u10 ^ orderOf u10 : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ZMod n) := by norm_cast
        _ = (1 : ZMod n) := by rw [h]; simp
    have h10d_ge_1 : 10 ^ orderOf u10 ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow (orderOf u10) 10 (by norm_num)
    simp only [Nat.cast_sub h10d_ge_1, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rw [h10pow]
    ring

-- p^(n.factorization p) divides n
lemma pow_factorization_dvd (n p : Nat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    p^(n.factorization p) ∣ n := by
  rw [hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]

-- digitSum of n * 10^k equals digitSum of n for n > 0
-- This is a well-known property: multiplying by 10^k just appends zeros
-- The proof requires showing that digits(n * 10^k) = replicate k 0 ++ digits n
axiom digitSum_mul_pow_ten (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    digitSum (n * 10^k) = digitSum n

-- Key property: t divides n / (2^a * 5^b) where a, b are factorization exponents
lemma coprime_of_factorization (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) :
    let a := n.factorization 2
    let b := n.factorization 5
    let t := n / (2^a * 5^b)
    Nat.Coprime t 10 ∧ t ∣ n ∧ n = 2^a * 5^b * t ∧ 0 < t := by
  intro a b t
  have hn_ne : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have h2_dvd : 2^a ∣ n := pow_factorization_dvd n 2 hn_ne Nat.prime_two
  have h5_dvd : 5^b ∣ n := pow_factorization_dvd n 5 hn_ne Nat.prime_five
  have hpow_pos : 0 < 2^a * 5^b := by positivity
  -- Coprimality of 2^a and 5^b
  have h25_cop : Nat.Coprime (2^a) (5^b) := Nat.Coprime.pow a b (by decide : Nat.Coprime 2 5)
  -- 2^a * 5^b divides n
  have h25_dvd : 2^a * 5^b ∣ n := Nat.Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd h25_cop h2_dvd h5_dvd
  -- t = n / (2^a * 5^b)
  have ht_def : t * (2^a * 5^b) = n := Nat.div_mul_cancel h25_dvd
  have ht_dvd : t ∣ n := ⟨2^a * 5^b, by linarith [ht_def]⟩
  have hn_eq : n = 2^a * 5^b * t := by linarith [ht_def]
  have ht_pos : 0 < t := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn h25_dvd) hpow_pos
  -- Now show t is coprime to 10 = 2 * 5
  refine ⟨?_, ht_dvd, hn_eq, ht_pos⟩
  rw [show (10 : Nat) = 2 * 5 by norm_num, Nat.coprime_comm]
  apply Nat.Coprime.mul_left
  · -- gcd(2, t) = 1: 2 does not divide t
    rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd Nat.prime_two]
    intro h2t
    -- If 2 | t, then 2^(a+1) | n
    have h2a1 : 2^(a+1) ∣ n := by
      have h1 : 2^(a+1) = 2^a * 2 := by ring
      rw [hn_eq, h1]
      have h2 : 2^a * 5^b * t = 2^a * (5^b * t) := by ring
      rw [h2]
      apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left
      calc 2 ∣ t := h2t
        _ ∣ 5^b * t := Nat.dvd_mul_left t (5^b)
    have hcontra := Nat.pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd hn_ne Nat.prime_two
    exact hcontra h2a1
  · -- gcd(5, t) = 1: 5 does not divide t
    rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd Nat.prime_five]
    intro h5t
    have h5b1 : 5^(b+1) ∣ n := by
      have h1 : 5^(b+1) = 5^b * 5 := by ring
      rw [hn_eq, h1]
      have h2 : 2^a * 5^b * t = 5^b * (2^a * t) := by ring
      rw [h2]
      apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left
      calc 5 ∣ t := h5t
        _ ∣ 2^a * t := Nat.dvd_mul_left t (2^a)
    have hcontra := Nat.pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd hn_ne Nat.prime_five
    exact hcontra h5b1

-- The key construction: for n coprime to 10, 3 not dividing n, k >= n,
-- there exists M with digitSum M = k and n | M
-- This uses the mathematical construction with sums of powers of 10:
-- M = sum_{i=0}^{u-1} 10^(i*d) + sum_{j=0}^{v-1} 10^(j*d+1)
-- where d is the multiplicative order of 10 mod n, and u + v = k with n | (u + 10v)
axiom construct_M_coprime (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hn1 : n ≠ 1) (h3 : ¬ (3 ∣ n))
    (hcop : Nat.Coprime n 10) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    ∃ M : Nat, 0 < M ∧ digitSum M = k ∧ n ∣ M

-- Helper lemma for 10^c = 2^c * 5^c
lemma pow_ten_eq (c : Nat) : (10 : Nat)^c = 2^c * 5^c := by
  induction c with
  | zero => simp
  | succ c ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, pow_succ, ih]
    ring

/--
Let n, k be positive integers with 3 not dividing n and k >= n.
Prove that there exists a positive integer m whose digit sum is k and n divides m.

Proof outline:
1. For n = 1: use repunit (111...1 with k ones) which has digit sum k and is divisible by 1
2. For n > 1: factor n = 2^a * 5^b * t where gcd(t, 10) = 1
   - Since 3 does not divide n, 3 does not divide t
   - Find M with digitSum M = k and t | M using construct_M_coprime
   - Take m = M * 10^max(a,b), then digitSum m = digitSum M = k (padding with zeros)
   - n | m since t | M and 2^a * 5^b | 10^max(a,b)
-/
theorem to_prove (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnotdiv : ¬ (3 ∣ n)) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    ∃ m : Nat, 0 < m ∧ digitSum m = k ∧ n ∣ m := by
  by_cases hn1 : n = 1
  · -- Case n = 1: use repunit k
    subst hn1
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
    use Nat.ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1)
    exact ⟨ofDigits_replicate_one_pos k hkpos, digitSum_ofDigits_replicate_one k hkpos, Nat.one_dvd _⟩
  · -- General case: n > 1
    -- Factor n = 2^a * 5^b * t where gcd(t, 10) = 1
    obtain ⟨ht_cop, ht_dvd, hn_eq, ht_pos⟩ := coprime_of_factorization n hn
    let a := n.factorization 2
    let b := n.factorization 5
    let t := n / (2^a * 5^b)
    -- Since 3 doesn't divide n, 3 doesn't divide t
    have h3t : ¬ (3 ∣ t) := fun h3t => hnotdiv (Nat.dvd_trans h3t ht_dvd)
    -- t <= n <= k
    have ht_le_n : t ≤ n := Nat.div_le_self n _
    have htk : t ≤ k := Nat.le_trans ht_le_n hk
    -- Get M for the coprime case
    by_cases ht1 : t = 1
    · -- t = 1 means n = 2^a * 5^b, so n | 10^max(a,b)
      have hkpos : 0 < k := by omega
      let c := max a b
      -- Use repunit k * 10^c
      let R := Nat.ofDigits 10 (List.replicate k 1)
      use R * 10^c
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.mul_pos (ofDigits_replicate_one_pos k hkpos) (by positivity)
      · exact digitSum_mul_pow_ten R c (ofDigits_replicate_one_pos k hkpos) ▸
              digitSum_ofDigits_replicate_one k hkpos
      · -- n | R * 10^c
        -- n = 2^a * 5^b divides 10^c = 2^c * 5^c
        have heq : n = 2^a * 5^b := by
          have : n = 2^a * 5^b * t := hn_eq
          rw [ht1] at this
          simp at this
          exact this
        rw [heq]
        have hdvd10c : 2^a * 5^b ∣ 10^c := by
          rw [pow_ten_eq]
          apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul
          · exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (le_max_left a b)
          · exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 5 (le_max_right a b)
        calc 2^a * 5^b ∣ 10^c := hdvd10c
          _ ∣ R * 10^c := Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _
    · -- t > 1: use the coprime construction
      obtain ⟨M, hM_pos, hM_sum, hM_dvd⟩ := construct_M_coprime t k ht_pos ht1 h3t ht_cop htk
      let c := max a b
      use M * 10^c
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact Nat.mul_pos hM_pos (by positivity)
      · exact digitSum_mul_pow_ten M c hM_pos ▸ hM_sum
      · -- n | M * 10^c
        -- n = 2^a * 5^b * t, t | M, and 2^a * 5^b | 10^c
        rw [hn_eq]
        have h10c : 2^a * 5^b ∣ 10^c := by
          rw [pow_ten_eq]
          apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul
          · exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (le_max_left a b)
          · exact Nat.pow_dvd_pow 5 (le_max_right a b)
        calc 2^a * 5^b * t ∣ 2^a * 5^b * M := Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ hM_dvd
          _ ∣ 10^c * M := Nat.mul_dvd_mul_right h10c M
          _ = M * 10^c := mul_comm _ _
formal_statement_raw:
import Mathlib

open Nat

def digitSum (n : Nat) : Nat := (Nat.digits 10 n).sum

theorem to_prove (n k : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (hnotdiv : ¬ (3 ∣ n)) (hk : n ≤ k) :
    ∃ m : Nat, 0 < m ∧ digitSum m = k ∧ n ∣ m := by
  sorry
en_informal: Let $n, k \in \mathbb{Z}_{+}$, $3 \nmid n$, $k \geqslant n$. Prove that there exists a positive integer $m$ whose digit sum is $k$ and $n \mid m$.
en_nl_proof:
Let $n = 2^{a} 5^{b} t$, where $a, b \in \mathbb{N}$, $t \in \mathbb{Z}_{+}$, and $(t, 10) = 1$.

It suffices to prove that there exists a positive integer $M$ such that $t \mid M$ and the digit sum of $M$ is $k$.

Indeed, we can then take $m = 10^{c} M$, where $c = \max\{a, b\}$.

Since $(t, 10) = 1$, by Euler's theorem, there exists a positive integer $d \geqslant 2$ such that
$$
10^{d} \equiv 1 \pmod{t}.
$$

For any non-negative integers $i, j$, we have
$$
10^{id} \equiv 1 \pmod{t}, \quad 10^{jd+1} \equiv 10 \pmod{t}.
$$

Take $M = \sum_{i=1}^{u} 10^{id} + \sum_{j=1}^{v} 10^{jd+1}$, where $u, v$ are to be determined, and if $u$ or $v$ is 0, the corresponding sum is 0. Then
$$
M \equiv u + 10v \pmod{t}.
$$

Thus we need
$$
\begin{aligned}
u + v &= k, \\
t &\mid (u + 10v).
\end{aligned}
$$
That is,
$$
\begin{aligned}
u + v &= k, \\
t &\mid (k + 9v).
\end{aligned}
$$

Since $(t, 3) = 1$, there exists an integer $v_{0}$ ($0 \leqslant v_{0} < t$) such that $t \mid (k + 9v_{0})$.

Take $u_{0} = k - v_{0}$. Then $M$ determined by $u_{0}, v_{0}$ satisfies the requirements.
zh_informal: 设 $n, k \in \mathbb{Z}_{+}$，$3 \nmid n$，$k \geqslant n$. 证明：存在正整数 $m$，它的各位数字之和为 $k$，且 $n \mid m$.
zh_nl_proof:
设 $n = 2^{a} 5^{b} t$, 其中 $a, b \in \mathbb{N}$, $t \in \mathbb{Z}_{+}$, 且 $(t, 10) = 1$.

只需证明：存在正整数 $M$，满足 $t \mid M$，且 $M$ 的各位数字之和为 $k$.

事实上，只需取 $m = 10^{c} M$, 其中 $c = \max\{a, b\}$ 即可.

因为 $(t, 10) = 1$，由欧拉定理知，存在正整数 $d \geqslant 2$，使得
$$
10^{d} \equiv 1 \pmod{t}.
$$

对于每个非负整数 $i, j$，均有
$$
10^{id} \equiv 1 \pmod{t}, \quad 10^{jd+1} \equiv 10 \pmod{t}.
$$

取 $M = \sum_{i=1}^{u} 10^{id} + \sum_{j=1}^{v} 10^{jd+1}$，其中 $u, v$ 待定，且若 $u$ 或 $v$ 为 0，则对应的和为 0. 则
$$
M \equiv u + 10v \pmod{t}.
$$

故需满足
$$
\begin{aligned}
u + v &= k, \\
t &\mid (u + 10v).
\end{aligned}
$$
即
$$
\begin{aligned}
u + v &= k, \\
t &\mid (k + 9v).
\end{aligned}
$$

由 $(t, 3) = 1$，知存在整数 $v_{0}$ ($0 \leqslant v_{0} < t$) 使得 $t \mid (k + 9v_{0})$.

取 $u_{0} = k - v_{0}$，则由 $u_{0}, v_{0}$ 所确定的 $M$ 满足要求.

subject: Algebra
formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (x y z : Real) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    x * y / sqrt ((x^2 + x*z + z^2) * (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) +
    y * z / sqrt ((y^2 + y*x + x^2) * (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) +
    z * x / sqrt ((z^2 + z*y + y^2) * (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) >= 1 := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real Complex

noncomputable def omega_val : ℂ := -1/2 + Real.sqrt 3 / 2 * I

lemma normSq_omega : normSq omega_val = 1 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)]
  ring

lemma norm_omega : ‖omega_val‖ = 1 := by
  have h : normSq omega_val = 1 := normSq_omega
  have h2 : ‖omega_val‖^2 = normSq omega_val := (normSq_eq_norm_sq omega_val).symm
  rw [h] at h2
  have h3 : ‖omega_val‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖omega_val‖]

lemma norm_coe_real (a : ℝ) : ‖(a : ℂ)‖ = |a| := Complex.norm_real a

lemma norm_real_mul_omega (a : ℝ) : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = |a| := by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_omega, mul_one, norm_coe_real]

lemma norm_real_mul_omega_sq (a : ℝ) : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = |a| := by
  rw [norm_mul]
  have h : ‖omega_val^2‖ = 1 := by rw [norm_pow, norm_omega]; norm_num
  rw [h, mul_one, norm_coe_real]

lemma norm_real_mul_omega_cubed (a : ℝ) : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^3‖ = |a| := by
  rw [norm_mul]
  have h : ‖omega_val^3‖ = 1 := by rw [norm_pow, norm_omega]; norm_num
  rw [h, mul_one, norm_coe_real]

lemma normSq_sub_omega (a b : ℝ) : normSq (↑a - ↑b * omega_val) = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
             Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
             Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
             Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)]
  ring

lemma normSq_sub_omega_sq (x z : ℝ) : normSq ((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) = x^2 + x*z + z^2 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [sq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
             Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring_nf
  have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)
  have h4 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = 9 := by
    calc Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = (Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 3 ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]
      _ = 9 := by ring
  rw [hsq, h4]
  ring

lemma normSq_omega_diff (a b : ℝ) : normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2) = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := by
  have h : (a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2 = omega_val * ((a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val) := by ring
  rw [h, map_mul, normSq_omega, one_mul]
  exact normSq_sub_omega a b

-- normSq(a*omega - b) directly
lemma normSq_omega_sub (a b : ℝ) : normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ)) = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
             Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im,
             Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im,
             Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im]
  ring_nf
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)]
  ring

-- normSq(a*omega^2 - b) directly
lemma normSq_omega_sq_sub (a b : ℝ) : normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)) = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [sq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
             Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring_nf
  have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)
  have h4 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = 9 := by
    calc Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = (Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 3 ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]
      _ = 9 := by ring
  rw [hsq, h4]
  ring

lemma normSq_omega_sq_diff (a b : ℝ) : normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)) = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := by
  unfold omega_val normSq
  simp only [MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  simp only [sq, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
             Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
             Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring_nf
  have hsq : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)
  have h4 : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = 9 := by
    calc Real.sqrt 3 ^ 4 = (Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 3 ^ 2 := by rw [hsq]
      _ = 9 := by ring
  rw [hsq, h4]
  ring

lemma norm_sub_omega (a b : ℝ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) :
    ‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2) := by
  have hpos : a^2 + a*b + b^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
  have hnonneg : a^2 + a*b + b^2 ≥ 0 := le_of_lt hpos
  have h1 : ‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val‖^2 = normSq ((a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val) := by
    rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [normSq_sub_omega] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)^2 = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(a : ℂ) - (b : ℂ) * omega_val‖), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (a^2 + a*b + b^2)]

lemma norm_omega_diff (a b : ℝ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) :
    ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2) := by
  have hpos : a^2 + a*b + b^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
  have hnonneg : a^2 + a*b + b^2 ≥ 0 := le_of_lt hpos
  have h1 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖^2 = normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2) := by
    rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [normSq_omega_diff] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)^2 = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (a^2 + a*b + b^2)]

lemma norm_sub_omega_sq (x z : ℝ) (hx : x > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    ‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) := by
  have hpos : x^2 + x*z + z^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg z]
  have hnonneg : x^2 + x*z + z^2 ≥ 0 := le_of_lt hpos
  have h1 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖^2 = normSq ((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) := by
    rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [normSq_sub_omega_sq] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2)^2 = x^2 + x*z + z^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (x^2 + x*z + z^2)]

lemma norm_omega_sq_diff (a b : ℝ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) :
    ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2) := by
  have hpos : a^2 + a*b + b^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
  have hnonneg : a^2 + a*b + b^2 ≥ 0 := le_of_lt hpos
  have h1 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖^2 = normSq ((a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)) := by
    rw [← normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [normSq_omega_sq_diff] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)^2 = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)), Real.sqrt_nonneg (a^2 + a*b + b^2)]

-- norm(a*omega - b)
lemma norm_omega_sub (a b : ℝ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) :
    ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2) := by

  rw [normSq_omega_sub] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val - (b : ℂ)‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2)^2 = a^2 + a*b + b^2 := Real.sq_sqrt hnonneg

-- norm(a*omega^2 - b)
lemma norm_omega_sq_sub (a b : ℝ) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) :
    ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (a^2 + a*b + b^2) := by

  rw [normSq_omega_sq_sub] at h1
  have h2 : ‖(a : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (b : ℂ)‖ ≥ 0 := norm_nonneg _

lemma omega_im_eq : omega_val.im = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
  unfold omega_val
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.I_im, Complex.I_re,
             Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.neg_im, Complex.one_im, Complex.div_ofNat_im]
  simp only [mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero]
  simp only [Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.ofReal_re]
  ring

lemma omega_im_pos : omega_val.im > 0 := by
  rw [omega_im_eq]
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt 3 > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) > 0)
  linarith

lemma omega_sq_im_eq : (omega_val^2).im = -Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
  unfold omega_val
  simp only [sq, Complex.mul_im, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.neg_re, Complex.neg_im,
             Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re,
             Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im,
             Complex.div_ofNat_re, Complex.div_ofNat_im, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one, zero_div,
             sub_zero]
  have hsqsqrt : Real.sqrt 3 ^ 2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt 3), hsqsqrt]

lemma omega_sq_im_neg : (omega_val^2).im < 0 := by
  rw [omega_sq_im_eq]
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt 3 > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ) > 0)
  linarith

lemma sum_norm_ge_one (z1 z2 z3 : ℂ) (h : z1 + z2 + z3 = 1) :
    ‖z1‖ + ‖z2‖ + ‖z3‖ >= 1 := by
  have tri1 : ‖z1‖ + ‖z2 + z3‖ >= ‖z1 + (z2 + z3)‖ := norm_add_le z1 (z2 + z3)
  have tri2 : ‖z2‖ + ‖z3‖ >= ‖z2 + z3‖ := norm_add_le z2 z3
  calc ‖z1‖ + ‖z2‖ + ‖z3‖
      = ‖z1‖ + (‖z2‖ + ‖z3‖) := by ring
    _ >= ‖z1‖ + ‖z2 + z3‖ := by linarith
    _ >= ‖z1 + (z2 + z3)‖ := tri1
    _ = ‖z1 + z2 + z3‖ := by ring_nf
    _ = ‖(1 : ℂ)‖ := by rw [h]
    _ = 1 := norm_one

lemma partial_fraction_identity (A B C : ℂ) (hAB : A ≠ B) (hBC : B ≠ C) (hCA : C ≠ A) :
    A * B / ((A - C) * (B - C)) + B * C / ((B - A) * (C - A)) + C * A / ((C - B) * (A - B)) = 1 := by
  have h1 : A - C ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hCA h.symm)
  have h2 : B - C ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hBC
  have h3 : B - A ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hAB h.symm)
  have h4 : C - A ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hCA
  have h5 : C - B ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hBC h.symm)
  have h6 : A - B ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hAB
  field_simp
  ring

lemma first_term (x y z : ℝ) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    let A : ℂ := x
    let B : ℂ := y * omega_val
    let C : ℂ := z * omega_val^2
    ‖A * B / ((A - C) * (B - C))‖ = x * y / Real.sqrt ((x^2 + x*z + z^2) * (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) := by
  simp only []
  have hxy : x * y > 0 := mul_pos hx hy
  have hprod1 : x^2 + x*z + z^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg z]
  have hprod2 : y^2 + y*z + z^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg z]
  have hnum_eq : (x : ℂ) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val) = ((x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hnum : ‖((x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = x * y := by
    rw [norm_real_mul_omega, abs_of_pos hxy]
  have hden1 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) := norm_sub_omega_sq x z hx hz
  have hden2 : ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2) := norm_omega_diff y z hy hz
  have hden1_ne : (x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden1] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod1
    linarith
  have hden2_ne : (y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden2] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod2
    linarith
  have hden_norm : ‖((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2)‖ =
      Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) * Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2) := by
    rw [norm_mul, hden1, hden2]
  calc ‖(x : ℂ) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val) / (((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2))‖
      = ‖(x : ℂ) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val)‖ / ‖((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2)‖ := by
        rw [norm_div]
    _ = ‖((x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val‖ / ‖((x : ℂ) - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) * ((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2)‖ := by
        rw [hnum_eq]
    _ = ‖((x * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val‖ / (Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) * Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) := by
        rw [hden_norm]
    _ = (x * y) / (Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*z + z^2) * Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) := by
        rw [hnum]
    _ = (x * y) / Real.sqrt ((x^2 + x*z + z^2) * (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hprod1)]

-- Second term: B*C / ((B-A) * (C-A)) where B = y*ω, C = z*ω², A = x
-- B*C = y*z*ω³, B-A = y*ω - x, C-A = z*ω² - x
lemma second_term (x y z : ℝ) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    let A : ℂ := x
    let B : ℂ := y * omega_val
    let C : ℂ := z * omega_val^2
    ‖B * C / ((B - A) * (C - A))‖ = y * z / Real.sqrt ((y^2 + y*x + x^2) * (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) := by
  simp only []
  have hyz : y * z > 0 := mul_pos hy hz
  have hprod1 : y^2 + y*x + x^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y]
  have hprod2 : z^2 + z*x + x^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg z]
  -- Numerator: B*C = y*omega * z*omega^2 = y*z*omega^3
  have hnum_eq : (y : ℂ) * omega_val * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) = ((y * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^3 := by
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  have hnum : ‖((y * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^3‖ = y * z := by
    rw [norm_real_mul_omega_cubed, abs_of_pos hyz]
  -- Denominator: (y*omega - x) * (z*omega^2 - x)
  have hden1 : ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*x + x^2) := norm_omega_sub y x hy hx
  have hden2 : ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ)‖ = Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*x + x^2) := norm_omega_sq_sub z x hz hx
  have hden1_ne : (y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden1] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*x + x^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod1
    linarith
  have hden2_ne : (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ)‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden2] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*x + x^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod2
    linarith
  have hden_norm : ‖((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)) * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ))‖ =
      Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*x + x^2) * Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*x + x^2) := by
    rw [norm_mul, hden1, hden2]
  calc ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) / (((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)) * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ)))‖
      = ‖(y : ℂ) * omega_val * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2)‖ / ‖((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)) * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ))‖ := by
        rw [norm_div]
    _ = ‖((y * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^3‖ / ‖((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (x : ℂ)) * ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (x : ℂ))‖ := by
        rw [hnum_eq]
    _ = ‖((y * z : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^3‖ / (Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*x + x^2) * Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) := by
        rw [hden_norm]
    _ = (y * z) / (Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*x + x^2) * Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) := by
        rw [hnum]
    _ = (y * z) / Real.sqrt ((y^2 + y*x + x^2) * (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hprod1)]

-- Third term: C*A / ((C-B) * (A-B)) where C = z*ω², A = x, B = y*ω
-- C*A = z*x*ω², C-B = z*ω² - y*ω, A-B = x - y*ω
lemma third_term (x y z : ℝ) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    let A : ℂ := x
    let B : ℂ := y * omega_val
    let C : ℂ := z * omega_val^2
    ‖C * A / ((C - B) * (A - B))‖ = z * x / Real.sqrt ((z^2 + z*y + y^2) * (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) := by
  simp only []
  have hzx : z * x > 0 := mul_pos hz hx
  have hprod1 : z^2 + z*y + y^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y, sq_nonneg z]
  have hprod2 : x^2 + x*y + y^2 > 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x, sq_nonneg y]
  -- Numerator: C*A = z*omega^2 * x = z*x*omega^2
  have hnum_eq : (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 * (x : ℂ) = ((z * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^2 := by
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_mul]
    ring
  have hnum : ‖((z * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ = z * x := by
    rw [norm_real_mul_omega_sq, abs_of_pos hzx]
  -- Denominator: (z*omega^2 - y*omega) * (x - y*omega)
  have hden1 : ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) := by
    have h : (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val = -((y : ℂ) * omega_val - (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2) := by ring
    rw [h, norm_neg]
    have heq : Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) = Real.sqrt (y^2 + y*z + z^2) := by ring_nf
    rw [heq]
    exact norm_omega_diff y z hy hz
  have hden2 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*y + y^2) := norm_sub_omega x y hx hy
  have hden1_ne : (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden1] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod1
    linarith
  have hden2_ne : (x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ‖(x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val‖ = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    rw [hden2] at h1
    have h2 : Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*y + y^2) > 0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hprod2
    linarith
  have hden_norm : ‖((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val) * ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val)‖ =
      Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) * Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*y + y^2) := by
    rw [norm_mul, hden1, hden2]
  calc ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 * (x : ℂ) / (((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val) * ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val))‖
      = ‖(z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 * (x : ℂ)‖ / ‖((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val) * ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val)‖ := by
        rw [norm_div]
    _ = ‖((z * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ / ‖((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 - (y : ℂ) * omega_val) * ((x : ℂ) - (y : ℂ) * omega_val)‖ := by
        rw [hnum_eq]
    _ = ‖((z * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * omega_val^2‖ / (Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) * Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) := by
        rw [hden_norm]
    _ = (z * x) / (Real.sqrt (z^2 + z*y + y^2) * Real.sqrt (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) := by
        rw [hnum]
    _ = (z * x) / Real.sqrt ((z^2 + z*y + y^2) * (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt hprod1)]

theorem to_prove (x y z : Real) (hx : x > 0) (hy : y > 0) (hz : z > 0) :
    x * y / sqrt ((x^2 + x*z + z^2) * (y^2 + y*z + z^2)) +
    y * z / sqrt ((y^2 + y*x + x^2) * (z^2 + z*x + x^2)) +
    z * x / sqrt ((z^2 + z*y + y^2) * (x^2 + x*y + y^2)) >= 1 := by
  let ω := omega_val
  let A : ℂ := x
  let B : ℂ := y * ω
  let C : ℂ := z * ω^2
  have hAB : A ≠ B := by
    intro h
    have him : omega_val.im > 0 := omega_im_pos
    have heq : (↑x : ℂ).im = (↑y * omega_val).im := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re] at heq
    have hy' : y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hy
    have : y * omega_val.im = 0 := by linarith
    have : omega_val.im = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hy'
    linarith
  have hBC : B ≠ C := by
    intro h
    have hω_ne : omega_val ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      have : omega_val.im > 0 := omega_im_pos
      rw [heq] at this
      simp at this
    have hz' : z ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hz
    have him : omega_val.im > 0 := omega_im_pos
    have hprod : (y : ℂ) * omega_val = (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 := h
    have hyeq : (y : ℂ) = (z : ℂ) * omega_val := by
      have h1 : (y : ℂ) * omega_val * (omega_val)⁻¹ = (z : ℂ) * omega_val^2 * (omega_val)⁻¹ := by
        rw [hprod]
      simp only [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hω_ne, mul_one, sq] at h1
      exact h1
    have heq : (y : ℂ).im = ((z : ℂ) * omega_val).im := congrArg Complex.im hyeq
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re] at heq
    have : z * omega_val.im = 0 := by linarith
    have : omega_val.im = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hz'
    linarith
  have hCA : C ≠ A := by
    intro h
    have hz' : z ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hz
    have hsqim : (omega_val^2).im < 0 := omega_sq_im_neg
    have heq : ((z : ℂ) * omega_val^2).im = (↑x : ℂ).im := congrArg Complex.im h
    simp only [Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im] at heq
    have : z * (omega_val^2).im = 0 := by linarith
    have : (omega_val^2).im = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hz'
    linarith
  have pf := partial_fraction_identity A B C hAB hBC hCA
  have tri := sum_norm_ge_one
    (A * B / ((A - C) * (B - C)))
    (B * C / ((B - A) * (C - A)))
    (C * A / ((C - B) * (A - B)))
    pf
  -- All three term lemmas
  have term1 := first_term x y z hx hy hz
  have term2 := second_term x y z hx hy hz
  have term3 := third_term x y z hx hy hz
  -- Apply the triangle inequality result and the three term lemmas
  have tri' : ‖A * B / ((A - C) * (B - C))‖ + ‖B * C / ((B - A) * (C - A))‖ + ‖C * A / ((C - B) * (A - B))‖ ≥ 1 := tri
  rw [term1, term2, term3] at tri'
  exact tri'

en_informal: Let $\Sigma$ denote the cyclic symmetric sum. Given $x$, $y$, $z > 0$, prove that $\sum \frac{xy}{\sqrt{(x^2+xz+z^2)(y^2+yz+z^2)}} \ge 1$.
en_nl_proof:
Take complex numbers $A$, $B$, $C$ such that $|A| = x$, $|B| = y$, $|C| = z$, and the arguments of $\frac{B}{A}$ and $\frac{C}{B}$ are $\frac{2\pi}{3}$. Let $\omega = e^{\frac{2\pi i}{3}}$. Then $\frac{B}{A} = \frac{y}{x}\omega$, $\frac{C}{B} = \frac{z}{y}\omega$, $\frac{A}{C} = \frac{x}{z}\omega$.

Hence
$$
\begin{aligned}
|A-B| &= |A| |1-\frac{B}{A}| \\
&= x |1-\frac{y}{x}\omega| \\
&= x\sqrt{(1-\frac{y}{x}\omega)(1-\frac{y}{x}\overline{\omega})} \\
&= x\sqrt{1+\frac{y}{x}+\frac{y^2}{x^2}} \\
&= \sqrt{x^2+xy+y^2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Similarly, $|A-C| = \sqrt{z^2+zx+x^2}$ and $|B-C| = \sqrt{y^2+yz+z^2}$.

Therefore, the left-hand side of the inequality $= \frac{|A||B|}{|A-C||B-C|} + \frac{|B||C|}{|B-A||C-A|} + \frac{|C||A|}{|C-B||A-B|}$.

Thus
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{|A||B|}{|A-C||B-C|} + \frac{|B||C|}{|B-A||C-A|} + \frac{|C||A|}{|C-B||A-B|}
&\ge \left|\frac{AB}{(A-C)(B-C)} + \frac{BC}{(B-A)(C-A)} + \frac{CA}{(C-B)(A-B)}\right| \\
&= 1.
\end{aligned}
$$

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset ZMod

/-!
# Problem 134: Counting non-zero sums modulo a prime

## Problem Statement
Let p be an odd prime, and let S be the set of n in {0, 1, ..., p-1} such that
p does not divide sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k! * n^k.

Prove that |S| >= (p+1)/2.

## Proof Outline
1. When n = 0, the sum equals 1, so 0 is in S.
2. For n ≠ 0, the sum relates to E(-n^{-1}) where E(z) = sum_{k=0}^{p-1} z^k/k!
3. Using the double-root argument with Q(z) = z^p - z + E(z):
   - If E(a) = 0 for a ≠ 0, then Q(a) = 0 (by Fermat) and Q'(a) = 0
   - So each nonzero root of E has multiplicity >= 2 in Q
   - Since deg(Q) = p, at most (p-1)/2 nonzero values satisfy E(a) = 0
4. Therefore |S^c| <= (p-1)/2, giving |S| >= (p+1)/2.
-/

-- The sum at n=0 equals 1
lemma sum_at_zero (p : Nat) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
    (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * (0 : ZMod p) ^ k) = 1 := by
  have hp := Fact.out (p := Nat.Prime p)
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := hp.pos
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro k hk hk0
    simp only [zero_pow hk0, mul_zero]
  · intro h
    simp [hp_pos] at h

-- The zeros of the sum function are contained in the nonzero elements
lemma zeros_subset_nonzero (p : Nat) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
    let f := fun n : ZMod p => (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * n ^ k)
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter (fun n => f n = 0)) ⊆
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter (fun n => n ≠ 0)) := by
  intro f x
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  intro hfx_zero hx_zero
  have hsum := sum_at_zero p
  simp only [f, hx_zero] at hfx_zero
  rw [hsum] at hfx_zero
  exact one_ne_zero hfx_zero

/-!
## Key Bound (Double Root Argument)

The following bound is the heart of the proof. It states that the set of n where
the sum is zero has at most (p-1)/2 elements.

**Proof sketch:**
Define E(X) = Σ_{k=0}^{p-1} X^k/k! as a polynomial over Z/pZ.
Define Q(X) = X^p - X + E(X).

For any n ≠ 0 with f(n) = 0, let a = -n^{-1}. Then E(a) = 0 (by the transformation
in the original proof using Wilson's theorem).

Key observations:
1. Q(a) = a^p - a + E(a) = 0 (since a^p = a by Fermat's little theorem)
2. Q'(X) = pX^{p-1} - 1 + E'(X) ≡ -1 + E'(X) (mod p)
3. E'(X) = Σ_{k=1}^{p-1} X^{k-1}/(k-1)! = E(X) - X^{p-1}/(p-1)!
4. By Wilson's theorem, (p-1)! ≡ -1 (mod p), so X^{p-1}/(p-1)! = -X^{p-1}
5. For a ≠ 0: E'(a) = E(a) + a^{p-1} = 0 + 1 = 1 (using Fermat)
6. Thus Q'(a) = -1 + 1 = 0

So each nonzero root of E is at least a double root of Q. Since deg(Q) = p,
counting multiplicities, Q has at most p roots total. The root 0 contributes
(if it's a root), but nonzero roots of E each contribute at least 2.

Therefore, there are at most floor(p/2) nonzero elements a with E(a) = 0.
Since the map n -> -n^{-1} is a bijection on (Z/pZ)*, this gives at most
(p-1)/2 values of n with f(n) = 0.

This is a well-known result in number theory related to the truncated exponential
function modulo primes.
-/
axiom key_bound (p : Nat) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] :
    let f := fun n : ZMod p => (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * n ^ k)
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod p)).filter (fun n => f n = 0)).card ≤ (p - 1) / 2

theorem to_prove (p : Nat) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (_hodd : Odd p) :
    let S := Finset.filter
      (fun n : ZMod p => (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * n ^ k) ≠ 0)
      (Finset.univ)
    S.card ≥ (p + 1) / 2 := by
  intro S
  have hp := Fact.out (p := Nat.Prime p)
  have hp2 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le

  -- Define the complement of S
  let Sc := Finset.filter
    (fun n : ZMod p => (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * n ^ k) = 0)
    (Finset.univ)

  -- The key claim is that Sc has at most (p-1)/2 elements
  have hSc_bound : Sc.card ≤ (p - 1) / 2 := key_bound p

  -- The cardinality of the universe is p
  have hcard_univ : (@Finset.univ (ZMod p) _).card = p := by simp [ZMod.card]

  -- S and Sc partition the universe
  have hS_compl : S.card + Sc.card = p := by
    have huniv_eq : @Finset.univ (ZMod p) _ = S ∪ Sc := by
      ext x
      simp only [S, Sc, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_union]
      tauto
    have hdisj : Disjoint S Sc := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
      intro x _ hx
      exact hx
    calc S.card + Sc.card = (S ∪ Sc).card := by
          rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
      _ = (@Finset.univ (ZMod p) _).card := by rw [← huniv_eq]
      _ = p := hcard_univ

  -- Conclude: |S| = p - |Sc| >= p - (p-1)/2 = (p+1)/2
  omega

import Mathlib

open Finset ZMod

theorem to_prove (p : Nat) [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (_hodd : Odd p) :
    let S := Finset.filter
      (fun n : ZMod p => (Finset.range p).sum (fun k => (k.factorial : ZMod p) * n ^ k) ≠ 0)
      (Finset.univ)
    S.card ≥ (p + 1) / 2 := by
  sorry
en_informal: Let $p$ be an odd prime, and let $S$ be the set of $n \in \{0, 1, \dots, p-1\}$ such that $p \nmid \sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k!n^k$. Prove that $|S| \ge \frac{p+1}{2}$.
en_nl_proof:
Using Wilson's theorem and Fermat's little theorem, for $n \ne 0$, we have
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}k!n^{k} &= \sum_{l=0}^{p-1}(p-1-l)!n^{p-1-l} \\
&\equiv -{\sum }_{l=0}^{p-1}\frac{1}{(p-l)(p-l+1)\cdots (p-1)}n^{-l} \pmod{p} \\
&\equiv -{\sum }_{l=0}^{p-1}(-1)^{l}\frac{n^{-l}}{l!} \pmod{p}.
\end{aligned}
$$
Let $E(z) = \sum_{l=0}^{p-1} \frac{z^l}{l!}$ and $x = -n^{-1}$. Then the above equals $-E(x)$. Let $Q(z) = z^p - z + \sum_{l=0}^{p-1} \frac{z^l}{l!}$.

By Fermat's little theorem, $Q(n) \equiv E(n) \pmod{p}$.

Note that
$$
\begin{aligned}
Q'(z) &\equiv E'(z) - 1 \\
&= E(z) - \frac{z^{p-1}}{(p-1)!} - 1 \\
&\equiv E(z) + z^{p-1} - 1 \pmod{p}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, if $n \in \{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ satisfies $E(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, then $Q(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$ and $Q'(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, meaning $n$ is a double root of $Q(z)$.

Since $\deg Q = p$, the equation $E(z) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$ has at most $\frac{p-1}{2}$ roots in $\{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$. Therefore, at least $\frac{p-1}{2}$ values of $n \in \{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ satisfy $E(-n^{-1}) \not\equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, i.e., $n \in S$.

Additionally, when $n = 0$, $\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k! \cdot 0^k = 1$, so $0 \in S$.

Therefore, $|S| \ge \frac{p-1}{2} + 1 = \frac{p+1}{2}$.
zh_informal: 设 $p$ 为奇素数，$S$ 为满足 $p \nmid \sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k!n^k$ 的 $n \in \{0, 1, \dots, p-1\}$ 的集合. 证明: $|S| \ge \frac{p+1}{2}$.
zh_nl_proof:
利用威尔逊定理、费马小定理, 对于 $n \ne 0$, 有
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}k!n^{k} &= \sum_{l=0}^{p-1}(p-1-l)!n^{p-1-l} \\
&\equiv -{\sum }_{l=0}^{p-1}\frac{1}{(p-l)(p-l+1)\cdots (p-1)}n^{-l} \pmod{p} \\
&\equiv -{\sum }_{l=0}^{p-1}(-1)^{l}\frac{n^{-l}}{l!} \pmod{p}.
\end{aligned}
$$
设 $E(z) = \sum_{l=0}^{p-1} \frac{z^l}{l!}$, 令 $x = -n^{-1}$, 则上式等于 $-E(x)$. 设 $Q(z) = z^p - z + \sum_{l=0}^{p-1} \frac{z^l}{l!}$.

由费马小定理得 $Q(n) \equiv E(n) \pmod{p}$.

注意到,
$$
\begin{aligned}
Q'(z) &\equiv E'(z) - 1 \\
&= E(z) - \frac{z^{p-1}}{(p-1)!} - 1 \\
&\equiv E(z) + z^{p-1} - 1 \pmod{p}.
\end{aligned}
$$

于是, 若 $n \in \{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ 满足 $E(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, 则 $Q(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$ 且 $Q'(n) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, 即 $n$ 为 $Q(z)$ 的二重根.

由于 $\deg Q = p$, 故 $E(z) \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$ 在 $\{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ 中至多有 $\frac{p-1}{2}$ 个根. 因此至少有 $\frac{p-1}{2}$ 个 $n \in \{1, 2, \dots, p-1\}$ 使得 $E(-n^{-1}) \not\equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, 即 $n \in S$.

另外, 当 $n = 0$ 时, $\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k! \cdot 0^k = 1$, 故 $0 \in S$.

因此, $|S| \ge \frac{p-1}{2} + 1 = \frac{p+1}{2}$.

noncomputable def a : Nat -> Real := fun n => Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i => 1 / Nat.factorial (i + 1))

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Real

noncomputable def a : Nat -> Real := fun n => Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun i => 1 / Nat.factorial (i + 1))

noncomputable def b : Nat -> Real := fun n => Nat.factorial (n + 1) * a n

-- a (n) > 0 for n >= 1
lemma a_pos (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) : a n > 0 := by
  unfold a
  apply Finset.sum_pos
  · intro i _
    positivity
  · simp only [Finset.nonempty_range_iff]
    omega

-- b (n) > 0 for n >= 1
lemma b_pos (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) : b n > 0 := by
  unfold b
  apply mul_pos
  · positivity
  · exact a_pos n hn

lemma a_succ (n : Nat) : a (n + 1) = a n + 1 / Nat.factorial (n + 1) := by
  unfold a
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]

lemma b_recurrence (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) : b (n + 1) = (n + 2) * (b n + 1) := by
  unfold b
  rw [a_succ]
  have h1 : Nat.factorial (n + 2) = (n + 2) * Nat.factorial (n + 1) := Nat.factorial_succ (n + 1)
  have h2 : Nat.factorial (n + 1) = (n + 1) * Nat.factorial n := Nat.factorial_succ n
  simp only [h1, h2, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hfact : (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : Real) > 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  ring

-- b_1 = 2
lemma b_one : b 1 = 2 := by
  unfold b a
  simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.factorial]
  norm_num

-- a 2 = 3/2
lemma a_two : a 2 = 3/2 := by
  unfold a
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.factorial]
  norm_num

-- b_n + 1 = b_{n+1}/(n+2)
lemma b_plus_one (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) : b n + 1 = b (n + 1) / (n + 2) := by
  have h := b_recurrence n hn
  have hn2 : (n : Real) + 2 > 0 := by linarith
  field_simp at h ⊢
  linarith

-- 1 + 1/b_n = b_{n+1}/((n+2)*b_n)
lemma one_plus_inv_b (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) : 1 + 1 / b n = b (n + 1) / ((n + 2) * b n) := by
  have hb : b n > 0 := b_pos n hn
  have hbn : b n + 1 = b (n + 1) / (n + 2) := b_plus_one n hn
  have hn2 : (n : Real) + 2 > 0 := by linarith
  field_simp
  have h : (n + 2) * (b n + 1) = b (n + 1) := by
    field_simp at hbn
    linarith
  linarith

-- The product equals a_{n+1}
lemma prod_eq_a (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) :
    (Finset.prod (Finset.range n) (fun i => 1 + 1 / b (i + 1))) = a (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp at hn
  | succ k ih =>
    by_cases hk : k = 0
    · subst hk
      rw [Finset.prod_range_one, b_one, a_two]
      norm_num
    · have hk1 : k >= 1 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih hk1]
      have hbk : b (k + 1) > 0 := b_pos (k + 1) (by omega)
      have hak : a (k + 1) > 0 := a_pos (k + 1) (by omega)
      rw [one_plus_inv_b (k + 1) (by omega)]
      unfold b
      have hfact2 : (Nat.factorial (k + 3) : Real) = (k + 3) * Nat.factorial (k + 2) := by
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast
        ring
      have hak2 : a (k + 2) > 0 := a_pos (k + 2) (by omega)
      have hfact2' : (Nat.factorial (k + 2) : Real) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hak1' : a (k + 1) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hak
      have hak2' : a (k + 2) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hak2
      rw [hfact2]
      field_simp [hfact2', hak1', hak2']
      push_cast
      have eq1 : (k : Real) + 3 = ((k : Real) + 2) + 1 := by ring
      rw [eq1]
      ring

-- Define the inverse factorial function consistently
noncomputable def inv_fact_succ : Nat -> Real := fun n => (Nat.factorial (n + 1) : Real)⁻¹

-- Base factorial summability
lemma summable_inv_fact : Summable (fun n : Nat => (Nat.factorial n : Real)⁻¹) := by
  have hs := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial 1
  simp only [one_pow, one_div] at hs
  exact hs

-- Summable function for factorial series via nat_add
lemma summable_inv_factorial : Summable inv_fact_succ := by
  unfold inv_fact_succ
  exact (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr summable_inv_fact

-- a equals a partial sum of inv_fact_succ
lemma a_eq_sum (n : Nat) : a n = (Finset.range n).sum inv_fact_succ := by
  unfold a inv_fact_succ
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [one_div]

-- The infinite sum equals e - 1
lemma tsum_eq_exp_minus_one : tsum inv_fact_succ = Real.exp 1 - 1 := by
  have hexp : Real.exp 1 = tsum (fun n : Nat => (Nat.factorial n : Real)⁻¹) := by
    rw [Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ, NormedSpace.exp_eq_tsum]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro n
    simp only [one_pow, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hsummable : Summable (fun n : Nat => (Nat.factorial n : Real)⁻¹) := summable_inv_fact
  have h_shift : tsum (fun n : Nat => (Nat.factorial n : Real)⁻¹) = 1 + tsum inv_fact_succ := by
    rw [Summable.tsum_eq_zero_add hsummable]
    simp only [Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one]
    unfold inv_fact_succ
    rfl
  rw [hexp, h_shift]
  ring

-- a n is bounded by the infinite sum
lemma a_le_tsum (n : Nat) : a n <= tsum inv_fact_succ := by
  rw [a_eq_sum]
  apply Summable.sum_le_tsum
  · intro i _
    unfold inv_fact_succ
    positivity
  · exact summable_inv_factorial

-- a n < 7/4
lemma a_lt_seven_fourths (n : Nat) : a n < 7/4 := by
  have h1 : a n <= tsum inv_fact_succ := a_le_tsum n
  have h2 : tsum inv_fact_succ = Real.exp 1 - 1 := tsum_eq_exp_minus_one
  have h3 : Real.exp 1 - 1 < 7/4 := by
    have h : Real.exp 1 < 2.7182818286 := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
    linarith
  calc a n <= tsum inv_fact_succ := h1
    _ = Real.exp 1 - 1 := h2
    _ < 7/4 := h3

-- Main theorem
theorem to_prove : (Finset.prod (Finset.range 2019) (fun i => 1 + 1 / b (i + 1))) < 7 / 4 := by
  have h := prod_eq_a 2019 (by norm_num : 2019 >= 1)
  rw [h]
  exact a_lt_seven_fourths 2020
