formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Real

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      let idx := ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real)
      let partialSum := Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a
      (idx ^ (i.val + 1) * a i) / (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1))) < 1 := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Real

/--
Given a_i > 0 for 1 <= i <= n, prove that
sum_{i=1}^{n} i^i * a_i / (i + a_1 + ... + a_i)^i < 1

The proof uses the AM-GM inequality and telescoping.

Key observations:
1. Note that i + a_1 + ... + a_i = (1 + a_1) + (1 + a_2) + ... + (1 + a_i)
2. By AM-GM: ((1+a_1) + ... + (1+a_i))/i >= ((1+a_1) * ... * (1+a_i))^(1/i)
3. Hence: i^i / (i + a_1 + ... + a_i)^i <= 1 / ((1+a_1) * ... * (1+a_i))
4. So: i^i * a_i / (i + sum)^i <= a_i / prod_{j<=i}(1+a_j)
5. The sum telescopes: sum of a_i/prod = 1 - 1/prod_all < 1
-/

-- Helper: filter set is nonempty
lemma filter_le_nonempty {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ).Nonempty := by
  simp only [Finset.filter_nonempty_iff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact ⟨i, le_refl i.val⟩

-- Helper: The cardinality of {j : Fin n | j.val <= i.val} is i.val + 1
lemma my_card_filter_le {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ).card = i.val + 1 := by
  have h1 : (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) = Finset.Iic i := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iic, Fin.le_def]
  rw [h1, Fin.card_Iic]

-- Helper: partial sum is positive
lemma partialSum_pos {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0)
    (i : Fin n) : Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a > 0 := by
  apply Finset.sum_pos
  · intro j _
    exact ha j
  · exact filter_le_nonempty i

-- Helper: product of (1 + a_j) is positive
lemma prodOnePlus_pos {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0)
    (i : Fin n) : Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) > 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j _
  linarith [ha j]

-- Helper: product over all elements is positive
lemma prodOnePlus_univ_pos {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) > 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j _
  linarith [ha j]

-- AM-GM inequality: (sum z_j / k)^k >= prod z_j (for positive z_j)
-- First establish: prod z <= (sum z / k)^k
lemma prod_le_arith_mean_pow {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (z : ι -> Real) (hz : forall i, i ∈ s -> z i > 0) :
    Finset.prod s z <= (Finset.sum s z / (s.card : Real)) ^ s.card := by
  have hcard_pos : (0 : Real) < s.card := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs)
  have hsum_pos : 0 < Finset.sum s z := Finset.sum_pos (fun i hi => hz i hi) hs
  have hprod_pos : 0 < Finset.prod s z := Finset.prod_pos (fun i hi => hz i hi)
  have amgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean s (fun _ => 1) z
    (fun _ _ => by norm_num) (by simp [Finset.card_pos.mpr hs]) (fun i hi => le_of_lt (hz i hi))
  simp only [Real.rpow_one, one_mul, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at amgm
  have key : ((Finset.prod s z) ^ ((s.card : Real)⁻¹)) ^ (s.card : Real) <=
             ((Finset.sum s z) / (s.card : Real)) ^ (s.card : Real) := by
    apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
    · apply Real.rpow_nonneg (le_of_lt hprod_pos)
    · exact amgm
    · exact le_of_lt hcard_pos
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hprod_pos)] at key
  simp only [inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hcard_pos), Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_natCast] at key
  exact key

-- sum (1 + a_j) = idx + sum a_j
lemma sum_one_plus_eq {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (i : Fin n) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) =
    ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real) + Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a := by
  set h_filter := Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const]
  have hcard : h_filter.card = i.val + 1 := my_card_filter_le i
  rw [hcard]
  simp [nsmul_eq_mul]

-- Helper for division inequality
lemma div_le_div_of_mul_le (a b c d : Real) (hb : b > 0) (hd : d > 0) (h : a * d <= c * b) :
    a / b <= c / d := by
  have h1 : a / b * (b * d) <= c / d * (b * d) := by
    calc a / b * (b * d) = a * d := by field_simp
      _ <= c * b := h
      _ = c / d * (b * d) := by field_simp
  have hbd_pos : b * d > 0 := mul_pos hb hd
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h1 hbd_pos

-- Helper: product of elements >= 1 is >= 1
lemma prod_ge_one {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι -> Real)
    (h : forall j, j ∈ s -> 1 <= f j) : 1 <= Finset.prod s f := by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert x s' hx ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hx]
    have h1 := h x (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    have h2 := ih (fun j hj => h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))
    have hprod_pos : 0 <= Finset.prod s' f := by
      apply Finset.prod_nonneg
      intro j hj
      have := h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
      linarith
    nlinarith

-- Helper: product of (1 + a_j) over all elements is > 1 when n > 0
lemma prodOnePlus_gt_one {n : Nat} (hn : n > 0) (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) > 1 := by
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.univ_nonempty_iff]
    exact Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hn
  obtain ⟨j0, hj0⟩ := hne
  have h2 : 1 + a j0 > 1 := by linarith [ha j0]
  have h3 : Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) =
            (1 + a j0) * Finset.prod (Finset.univ.erase j0) (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.insert_erase hj0, Finset.prod_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _)]
  have h4 : Finset.prod (Finset.univ.erase j0) (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) >= 1 := by
    by_cases hemp : (Finset.univ.erase j0).Nonempty
    · apply prod_ge_one
      intro j _
      linarith [ha j]
    · simp only [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
      rw [hemp, Finset.prod_empty]
  calc Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j)
      = (1 + a j0) * Finset.prod (Finset.univ.erase j0) (fun j => 1 + a j) := h3
    _ >= (1 + a j0) * 1 := by nlinarith [h4, ha j0]
    _ = 1 + a j0 := by ring
    _ > 1 := h2

-- Full term bound: (i^i * a_i) / (i + S_i)^i <= a_i / prod(1+a_j)
lemma full_term_bound {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    let idx := ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real)
    let partialSum := Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a
    let prodOnePlus := Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)
    (idx ^ (i.val + 1) * a i) / (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1) <= a i / prodOnePlus := by
  intro idx partialSum prodOnePlus
  set h_filter := Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ with h_filter_def
  have hne : h_filter.Nonempty := filter_le_nonempty i
  have hcard : h_filter.card = i.val + 1 := my_card_filter_le i
  have hz : ∀ j, j ∈ h_filter -> (1 + a j) > 0 := fun j _ => by linarith [ha j]
  have hprod_pos : prodOnePlus > 0 := Finset.prod_pos hz
  have hsum_pos : partialSum > 0 := Finset.sum_pos (fun j _ => ha j) hne
  have hidx_pos : idx > 0 := by simp only [idx]; positivity
  have hdenom_pos : idx + partialSum > 0 := by linarith
  have hai_pos : a i > 0 := ha i
  have h_sum_eq : Finset.sum h_filter (fun j => 1 + a j) = idx + partialSum := sum_one_plus_eq a i
  have amgm := prod_le_arith_mean_pow h_filter hne (fun j => 1 + a j) hz
  rw [h_sum_eq, hcard] at amgm
  have h_cast : ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real) = (i.val : Real) + 1 := by simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have amgm' : prodOnePlus <= ((idx + partialSum) / idx) ^ (i.val + 1) := by
    simp only [h_cast] at amgm
    convert amgm using 1
    simp only [idx, h_cast]
  have hkey : idx ^ (i.val + 1) * prodOnePlus <= (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1) := by
    have h2 : idx ^ (i.val + 1) * prodOnePlus <= idx ^ (i.val + 1) * ((idx + partialSum) / idx) ^ (i.val + 1) := by
      gcongr
    have h3 : idx ^ (i.val + 1) * ((idx + partialSum) / idx) ^ (i.val + 1) = (idx * ((idx + partialSum) / idx)) ^ (i.val + 1) := by
      rw [mul_pow]
    have h4_aux : idx * ((idx + partialSum) / idx) = idx + partialSum := by field_simp
    have h4 : (idx * ((idx + partialSum) / idx)) ^ (i.val + 1) = (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1) := by
      rw [h4_aux]
    linarith
  have hdenom_pow_pos : (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1) > 0 := by positivity
  apply div_le_div_of_mul_le
  · exact hdenom_pow_pos
  · exact hprod_pos
  · nlinarith [hkey, hai_pos, hprod_pos, hdenom_pow_pos]

-- Product decomposition: prod_{j<=i} = (1+a_i) * prod_{j<i}
lemma prod_filter_decompose {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (i : Fin n) :
    Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) =
    (1 + a i) * Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
  have h1 : Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ =
            insert i (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert]
    constructor
    · intro hj
      by_cases h : j = i
      · left; exact h
      · right; have : j.val ≠ i.val := fun heq => h (Fin.ext heq); omega
    · intro hj; cases hj with | inl h => rw [h] | inr h => omega
  have h2 : i ∉ Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, lt_self_iff_false, not_false_eq_true]
  rw [h1, Finset.prod_insert h2]

-- Product of filter_{j < i} is positive
lemma prod_filter_lt_pos {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) > 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j _
  linarith [ha j]

-- The key telescoping identity: a_i / prod_{j<=i}(1+a_j) = 1/prod_{j<i} - 1/prod_{j<=i}
lemma telescope_term {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) (i : Fin n) :
    a i / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) =
    1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) -
    1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
  set P_lt := Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)
  set P_le := Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)
  have hP_lt_pos : P_lt > 0 := prod_filter_lt_pos a ha i
  have hP_le_pos : P_le > 0 := prodOnePlus_pos a ha i
  have hP_rel : P_le = (1 + a i) * P_lt := prod_filter_decompose a i
  have hai_pos : a i > 0 := ha i
  have hP_lt_ne : P_lt ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hP_lt_pos
  rw [hP_rel]
  field_simp
  ring

-- Define the product function over first k elements for telescoping
def prodOnePlusLt {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (k : Nat) : Real :=
  Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < k) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)

-- Key properties for prodOnePlusLt
lemma prodOnePlusLt_zero {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) : prodOnePlusLt a 0 = 1 := by
  unfold prodOnePlusLt
  have h : Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < 0) Finset.univ = ∅ := by ext j; simp
  rw [h, Finset.prod_empty]

lemma prodOnePlusLt_n {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) : prodOnePlusLt a n = Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
  unfold prodOnePlusLt
  congr 1; ext j; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]; exact j.isLt

-- Filter equality: {j | j <= i} = {j | j < i+1}
lemma filter_le_eq_lt_succ {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ =
    Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val + 1) Finset.univ := by
  ext j; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]; omega

lemma prod_filter_le_eq_lt_succ {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (i : Fin n) :
    Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) =
    Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val + 1) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
  rw [filter_le_eq_lt_succ]

lemma prodOnePlusLt_eq {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (k : Nat) :
    prodOnePlusLt a k = Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < k) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) := rfl

-- Sum over Fin n = Sum over range n for the telescoping
lemma sum_fin_eq_sum_range_telescope {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) :
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) -
      1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) =
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => 1 / prodOnePlusLt a k - 1 / prodOnePlusLt a (k + 1)) := by
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [prodOnePlusLt_eq, prodOnePlusLt_eq, prod_filter_le_eq_lt_succ]

-- Telescoping sum over range n using Finset.sum_range_sub'
lemma telescoping_sum_range_eq {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) :
    Finset.sum (Finset.range n) (fun k => 1 / prodOnePlusLt a k - 1 / prodOnePlusLt a (k + 1)) =
    1 - 1 / Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_sub', prodOnePlusLt_zero, prodOnePlusLt_n]; simp

-- Apply telescope_term to convert sum of a_i/P_{<=i} to sum of (1/P_{<i} - 1/P_{<=i})
lemma sum_ai_div_prod_eq_telescope {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      a i / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) =
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val < i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j) -
      1 / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) := by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact telescope_term a ha i

-- Final telescoping sum theorem: sum of a_i/P_{<=i} = 1 - 1/P_all
theorem telescoping_sum_final {n : Nat} (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      a i / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) =
    1 - 1 / Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
  rw [sum_ai_div_prod_eq_telescope a ha, sum_fin_eq_sum_range_telescope, telescoping_sum_range_eq]

-- Main theorem
theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha : forall i, a i > 0) :
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
      let idx := ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real)
      let partialSum := Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a
      (idx ^ (i.val + 1) * a i) / (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1))) < 1 := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp only [Finset.sum_empty, zero_lt_one, univ_eq_empty]
  · have hn_pos : n > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    have h_prod_gt_one : Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) > 1 :=
      prodOnePlus_gt_one hn_pos a ha
    have h_prod_pos : Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j : Fin n => 1 + a j) > 0 :=
      prodOnePlus_univ_pos a ha
    -- Use full_term_bound to bound each term
    have h_sum_le : Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
        let idx := ((i.val + 1 : Nat) : Real)
        let partialSum := Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a
        (idx ^ (i.val + 1) * a i) / (idx + partialSum) ^ (i.val + 1)) <=
        Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
          a i / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact full_term_bound a ha i
    -- The sum of a_i/prod telescopes to 1 - 1/prod_all < 1
    -- Using telescope_term, each term equals 1/prod_{<i} - 1/prod_{<=i}
    -- The sum telescopes to 1 - 1/prod_all
    have h_sum_bound : Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i : Fin n =>
        a i / Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) (fun j => 1 + a j)) <=
        1 - 1 / Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
      -- The telescoping sum equals exactly 1 - 1/prod_all
      rw [telescoping_sum_final a ha]
    have h_lt_one : 1 - 1 / Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j => 1 + a j) < 1 := by
      have h1 : 0 < 1 / Finset.prod Finset.univ (fun j => 1 + a j) := by
        apply div_pos one_pos h_prod_pos
      linarith
    linarith

      let partialSum := Finset.sum (Finset.filter (fun j : Fin n => j.val <= i.val) Finset.univ) a

en_nl_proof:
Note that
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{i^i a_i}{(i + a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_i)^i}
&= \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{a_i}{\left(\frac{(1 + a_1) + (1 + a_2) + \dots + (1 + a_i)}{i}\right)^i} \\
&\le \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{a_i}{(1 + a_1) \cdot \dots \cdot (1 + a_i)} \\
&= \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( \frac{1}{(1 + a_1) \cdot \dots \cdot (1 + a_{i-1})} - \frac{1}{(1 + a_1) \cdot \dots \cdot (1 + a_i)} \right) \\
&= 1 - \frac{1}{(1 + a_1) \cdot \dots \cdot (1 + a_n)} < 1.
\end{aligned}
$$
Therefore, $\sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{i^i a_i}{(i + a_1 + \dots + a_i)^i} < 1$.

import Mathlib

open Real Finset BigOperators

/-- The sequence defined by a_0 = 2/3 and a_{n+1} = 2*a_n / (1 + a_n) -/
noncomputable def a : ℕ → ℝ
  | 0 => 2 / 3
  | n + 1 => 2 * a n / (1 + a n)

-- First, let's prove that a_n > 0 for all n
lemma a_pos : ∀ n : ℕ, a n > 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [a]; norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [a]
    have h1 : 1 + a n > 0 := by linarith
    positivity

-- Also a_n < 1
lemma a_lt_one : ∀ n : ℕ, a n < 1 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [a]; norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [a]
    have hp : a n > 0 := a_pos n
    have h1 : 1 + a n > 0 := by linarith
    rw [div_lt_one h1]
    linarith

-- Key lemma: 1/a_n = 1 + 1/2^(n+1) (adjusting for 0-indexing)
lemma inv_a_eq (n : ℕ) : (a n)⁻¹ = 1 + 1 / (2 : ℝ)^(n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [a]
    norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [a]
    have ha_pos : a n > 0 := a_pos n
    have h1 : 1 + a n ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h2 : a n ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha_pos
    have h3 : (2 : ℝ) * a n ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rw [inv_div]
    have ha_formula : a n = (2 : ℝ)^(n + 1) / ((2 : ℝ)^(n + 1) + 1) := by
      have := ih
      rw [inv_eq_one_div] at this
      have hne : (2 : ℝ)^(n + 1) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp at this ⊢
      linarith
    rw [ha_formula]
    field_simp
    ring

-- Product of sequence is positive
lemma prod_pos (n : ℕ) : (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) > 0 := by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro k _
  exact a_pos k

-- ln(1 + x) < x for x > 0
lemma log_one_add_lt (x : ℝ) (hx : x > 0) : Real.log (1 + x) < x := by
  have h1 : 1 + x > 0 := by linarith
  have h2 : x + 1 < Real.exp x := Real.add_one_lt_exp (ne_of_gt hx)
  have h3 : 1 + x < Real.exp x := by linarith
  have h4 : Real.log (1 + x) < Real.log (Real.exp x) := Real.log_lt_log h1 h3
  rw [Real.log_exp] at h4
  exact h4

-- ln(1/a_k) < 1/2^(k+1)
lemma log_inv_a_lt (k : ℕ) : Real.log ((a k)⁻¹) < 1 / (2 : ℝ)^(k + 1) := by
  rw [inv_a_eq]
  have h : 1 / (2 : ℝ)^(k + 1) > 0 := by positivity
  exact log_one_add_lt _ h

-- Geometric series sum lemma - strict
lemma geom_sum_lt_one (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 1) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^(k + 1) < 1 := by
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^(k + 1) =
      (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^k := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    ring
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^k < 2 := by
    have hp2 : ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n < 1 := by
      have h0 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < 1 := by norm_num
      have h1' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
      exact pow_lt_one₀ h1' h0 (by omega : n ≠ 0)
    have hp : ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ n > 0 := by positivity
    -- Use direct calculation instead of tsum
    have hsum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^k = (1 - (1/2)^n) / (1 - 1/2) := by
      have hne : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≠ 1 := by norm_num
      rw [geom_sum_eq hne n]
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    have : (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)^n) / (1 - 1/2) = 2 * (1 - (1/2)^n) := by ring
    rw [this]
    calc 2 * (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)^n) < 2 * 1 := by nlinarith
      _ = 2 := by ring
  have h3 : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2) ^ k < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 := by
    apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h2
    norm_num
  calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / 2) ^ k < (1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2 := h3
    _ = 1 := by ring

theorem to_prove : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ 1 → (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) > 1 / Real.exp 1 := by
  intro n hn
  have h_prod_pos : (∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, a k) > 0 := prod_pos n
  rw [gt_iff_lt, ← Real.log_lt_log_iff (by positivity) h_prod_pos]
  rw [Real.log_div (by norm_num) (by positivity : Real.exp 1 ≠ 0)]
  rw [Real.log_one, Real.log_exp]
  simp only [zero_sub]
  rw [Real.log_prod (Finset.range n) (fun k => a k) (fun k _ => ne_of_gt (a_pos k))]
  -- Goal: -1 < ∑ k in range n, log(a_k)
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.log (a k) = -∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.log ((a k)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [Real.log_inv (a k)]
    ring
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.log ((a k)⁻¹) < 1 := by
    calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, Real.log ((a k)⁻¹)
        < ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 / (2 : ℝ)^(k + 1)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty
          · simp only [Finset.nonempty_range_iff]; omega
          · intro k _; exact log_inv_a_lt k
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ((1 : ℝ) / 2)^(k + 1) := by
          congr 1; ext k
          rw [one_div, one_div, inv_pow]
      _ < 1 := geom_sum_lt_one n hn
  linarith

$$
\frac{1}{a_{n+1}}-1=\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{1}{a_{n}}-1\right) \Rightarrow \frac{1}{a_{n}}-1=\frac{1}{2^{n-1}}\left(\frac{1}{a_{1}}-1\right)=\frac{1}{2^{n}} \Rightarrow \frac{1}{a_{n}}=1+\frac{1}{2^{n}}.

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (hpos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (hcond : (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (a i))) = (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => a i))) :
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt ((a i)^2 + (a i) + 1))) <= Real.sqrt 3 * n := by

formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset Real BigOperators

-- Cauchy-Schwarz for sums: (sum sqrt(f*g))^2 <= (sum f)(sum g)
lemma cauchy_schwarz_sqrt_sum {n : Type*} [Fintype n] (f g : n -> Real)
    (hf : forall i, 0 <= f i) (hg : forall i, 0 <= g i) :
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (f i * g i)))^2 <=
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ f) * (Finset.sum Finset.univ g) := by
  let f' : EuclideanSpace Real n := fun i => Real.sqrt (f i)
  let g' : EuclideanSpace Real n := fun i => Real.sqrt (g i)
  have hinner : inner Real f' g' = Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (f i) * Real.sqrt (g i)) := by
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
    congr 1
    ext i
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
    ring
  have hsqrt_prod : forall i, Real.sqrt (f i) * Real.sqrt (g i) = Real.sqrt (f i * g i) := by
    intro i
    rw [<- Real.sqrt_mul (hf i)]
  simp_rw [hsqrt_prod] at hinner
  have hcs := @real_inner_le_norm (EuclideanSpace Real n) _ _ f' g'
  rw [hinner] at hcs
  have hnf : ‖f'‖ = Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ f) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hf i)]
  have hng : ‖g'‖ = Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ g) := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (hg i)]
  rw [hnf, hng] at hcs
  have hsum_f_nneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ f := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hf i)
  have hsum_g_nneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ g := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => hg i)
  have hsum_nneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (f i * g i)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hprod_nneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ f * Finset.sum Finset.univ g := mul_nonneg hsum_f_nneg hsum_g_nneg
  have hrhs : Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ f) * Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ g) = Real.sqrt (Finset.sum Finset.univ f * Finset.sum Finset.univ g) := by
    rw [<- Real.sqrt_mul hsum_f_nneg]
  rw [hrhs] at hcs
  have hcs_sq := sq_le_sq' (by linarith) hcs
  simp only [sq_sqrt hprod_nneg] at hcs_sq
  exact hcs_sq

-- The algebraic identity
lemma algebraic_identity (a : Real) (ha : 0 < a) :
    a^2 + a + 1 = (a + Real.sqrt a + 1) * (a - Real.sqrt a + 1) := by
  have hsq : Real.sqrt a ^ 2 = a := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt ha)
  ring_nf
  rw [hsq]
  ring

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (hpos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (hcond : (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (a i))) = (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => a i))) :
    (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt ((a i)^2 + (a i) + 1))) <= Real.sqrt 3 * n := by
  -- Let A = sum of sqrt(a_i) = sum of a_i
  set A := Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => a i) with hA_def
  -- First we need: A <= n (from Cauchy-Schwarz on sqrt(a_i))
  have hA_le_n : A <= n := by
    rw [<- hcond]
    have hcs := @sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (Fin n) Real _ _ _ _ Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (a i))
    have hsq : forall i, (Real.sqrt (a i))^2 = a i := fun i => Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (hpos i))
    simp only [hsq, card_fin] at hcs
    rw [hcond] at hcs
    have hnneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (a i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (a i)))]
  -- Rewrite the LHS using the algebraic identity
  have halg : forall i, (a i)^2 + (a i) + 1 = (a i + Real.sqrt (a i) + 1) * (a i - Real.sqrt (a i) + 1) := by
    intro i
    exact algebraic_identity (a i) (hpos i)
  simp_rw [halg]
  -- Define b_i = a_i + sqrt(a_i) + 1 and c_i = a_i - sqrt(a_i) + 1
  set b := fun i => a i + Real.sqrt (a i) + 1 with hb_def
  set c := fun i => a i - Real.sqrt (a i) + 1 with hc_def
  -- b_i > 0 and c_i > 0
  have hb_pos : forall i, 0 < b i := by
    intro i
    have ha_pos := hpos i
    have hsqrt_pos := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ha_pos
    linarith
  have hc_pos : forall i, 0 < c i := by
    intro i
    have ha_pos := hpos i
    have hsqrt_nneg := Real.sqrt_nonneg (a i)
    have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt ha_pos)
    have h1 : (Real.sqrt (a i) - 1)^2 >= 0 := sq_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  -- Apply Cauchy-Schwarz: (sum sqrt(b_i * c_i))^2 <= (sum b_i)(sum c_i)
  have hcs := cauchy_schwarz_sqrt_sum b c (fun i => le_of_lt (hb_pos i)) (fun i => le_of_lt (hc_pos i))
  -- sum b_i = sum a_i + sum sqrt(a_i) + n = A + A + n = 2A + n
  have hsum_b : Finset.sum Finset.univ b = 2 * A + n := by
    simp only [hb_def]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, card_fin]
    rw [hcond, hA_def]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  -- sum c_i = sum a_i - sum sqrt(a_i) + n = A - A + n = n
  have hsum_c : Finset.sum Finset.univ c = n := by
    simp only [hc_def]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, card_fin]
    rw [hcond, hA_def]
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    ring
  rw [hsum_b, hsum_c] at hcs
  -- (2A + n) * n <= 3n^2 since A <= n
  have hprod_bound : (2 * A + n) * n <= 3 * n^2 := by
    have h : 2 * A + n <= 3 * n := by linarith
    have hn_nneg : (0 : Real) <= n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    nlinarith
  have hsum_sqrt_nneg : 0 <= Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (b i * c i)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  -- sum sqrt(b_i * c_i) <= sqrt((2A+n)*n) <= sqrt(3n^2) = sqrt(3) * n
  have hprod_nneg : 0 <= (2 * A + n) * n := by
    have hn_nneg : (0 : Real) <= n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hA_nneg : 0 <= A := by
      rw [hA_def]
      apply Finset.sum_nonneg
      intro i _
      exact le_of_lt (hpos i)
    nlinarith
  have hbound : Real.sqrt ((2 * A + n) * n) <= Real.sqrt 3 * n := by
    have hn_nneg : (0 : Real) <= n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    calc Real.sqrt ((2 * A + n) * n) <= Real.sqrt (3 * n^2) := by
           apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
           exact hprod_bound
      _ = Real.sqrt 3 * Real.sqrt (n^2) := Real.sqrt_mul (by linarith : (0:Real) <= 3) _
      _ = Real.sqrt 3 * n := by rw [Real.sqrt_sq hn_nneg]
  have hsum_le_sqrt : Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => Real.sqrt (b i * c i)) <= Real.sqrt ((2 * A + n) * n) := by
    have h := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hcs
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq hsum_sqrt_nneg] at h
  linarith

en_informal: Positive real numbers $a_{1}$, $a_{2}$, $\ldots$, $a_{n}$ satisfy $\sqrt{a_{1}} + \sqrt{a_{2}} + \cdots + \sqrt{a_{n}} = a_{1} + a_{2} + \cdots + a_{n}$. Prove that $\sqrt{a_{1}^{2} + a_{1} + 1} + \sqrt{a_{2}^{2} + a_{2} + 1} + \cdots + \sqrt{a_{n}^{2} + a_{n} + 1} \leqslant \sqrt{3}n$.
en_nl_proof:
Let $A = \sqrt{a_{1}} + \sqrt{a_{2}} + \cdots + \sqrt{a_{n}} = a_{1} + a_{2} + \cdots + a_{n}$.

By the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality,
$$
\left( \sqrt{a_{1}} + \sqrt{a_{2}} + \cdots + \sqrt{a_{n}} \right)^{2} \leqslant n \left( a_{1} + a_{2} + \cdots + a_{n} \right) \Rightarrow A^{2} \leqslant nA \Rightarrow A \leqslant n.
$$

From $\sqrt{a^{2} + a + 1} = \sqrt{\left( a + \sqrt{a} + 1 \right) \left( a - \sqrt{a} + 1 \right)}$ and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality,
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}^{2} + a_{k} + 1} &= \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{\left( a_{k} + \sqrt{a_{k}} + 1 \right) \left( a_{k} - \sqrt{a_{k}} + 1 \right)} \\
&\leqslant \sqrt{\left( \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} + \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}} + n \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} - \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}} + n \right)} \\
&= \sqrt{\left( 2A + n \right) n} \leqslant \sqrt{3}n.
\end{aligned}
$$
zh_nl_proof:

由柯西不等式得
$$
\left( \sqrt{a_{1}} + \sqrt{a_{2}} + \cdots + \sqrt{a_{n}} \right)^{2} \leqslant n \left( a_{1} + a_{2} + \cdots + a_{n} \right) \Rightarrow A^{2} \leqslant nA \Rightarrow A \leqslant n.
$$

由 $\sqrt{a^{2} + a + 1} = \sqrt{\left( a + \sqrt{a} + 1 \right) \left( a - \sqrt{a} + 1 \right)}$ 及柯西不等式得
$$
\begin{aligned}
\sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}^{2} + a_{k} + 1} &= \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{\left( a_{k} + \sqrt{a_{k}} + 1 \right) \left( a_{k} - \sqrt{a_{k}} + 1 \right)} \\
&\leqslant \sqrt{\left( \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} + \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}} + n \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^{n} a_{k} - \sum_{k=1}^{n} \sqrt{a_{k}} + n \right)} \\
&= \sqrt{\left( 2A + n \right) n} \leqslant \sqrt{3}n.
\end{aligned}
$$

import Mathlib

open Finset

/-- Hall's Marriage Theorem: A system of sets A_1, ..., A_n (subsets of a finite set X)
    has a system of distinct representatives if and only if for any m sets,
    their union contains at least m elements. -/
theorem to_prove {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Finset α) :
    (∃ f : ι → α, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, f i ∈ A i) ↔
    (∀ s : Finset ι, s.card ≤ (s.biUnion A).card) := by
  sorry
en_informal: A production process consists of $n$ independent sequential stages, and there are $n$ workers. Each worker can complete certain stages but not others, and each worker can only work on one stage. Prove that the production process can be successfully completed if and only if any $m$ ($1 \leqslant m \leqslant n$) workers together can complete at least $m$ stages.
en_nl_proof:
Let the stages of the process form the set $X = \{x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n\}$, and let $A_i \subseteq X$ denote the stages that worker $i$ ($1 \leqslant i \leqslant n$) can complete.

Necessity.

Proof by contradiction. If there exist $m$ subsets whose union contains fewer than $m$ elements, then these $m$ workers cannot each independently complete a different stage, and thus the process cannot be completed.

Sufficiency.

Proof by induction. When $n = 1$, the conclusion holds.

For $n > 1$, assume $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_n$ satisfy the condition "any $m$ sets have a union containing at least $m$ elements." For $1 \leqslant l < n$, if the union of $l$ sets contains exactly $l$ elements, we call these $l$ sets a "matching family."

If no matching family exists, take any $x \in A_n$. Consider $A'_{i} = A_i \setminus \{x\}$ ($i = 1, 2, \dots, n - 1$). Then among the $n - 1$ sets $A'_1$, $A'_2$, $\dots$, $A'_{n - 1}$, any $m$ sets $A'_i$ still have a union containing at least $m$ elements. By the induction hypothesis, these $n - 1$ workers can each independently complete a different stage, and thus the process can be successfully completed.

If a matching family exists, assume after reordering that there exists $1 \leqslant l < n$ such that $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ form a matching family, so $|A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \dots \cup A_l| = l < n$.

By the induction hypothesis, $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ can complete $l$ stages as required. Let $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \dots \cup A_l = A$. For any $m$ of the remaining sets $A_{l+1}$, $A_{l+2}$, $\dots$, $A_n$, their union with $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ contains at least $l + m$ elements, so these $m$ sets contain at least $m$ elements outside of $A$. Construct sets $A'_i = A_i \setminus A$ ($i = l + 1$, $l + 2$, $\dots$, $n$). By the induction hypothesis, $A_{l+1}$, $A_{l+2}$, $\dots$, $A_n$ can complete the remaining $n - l$ stages, and thus the process can be successfully completed.
zh_informal: 一场工序有 $n$ 个独立的串联环节，共有 $n$ 个工人，每个工人有若干能完成的环节，其他环节均不能完成，且每个工人只能从事一道环节. 证明：这场工序能顺利完成的充分必要条件是任意 $m$ ($1 \leqslant m \leqslant n$) 个工人共有至少 $m$ 道能完成的环节.
zh_nl_proof:
设该工序的各环节构成集合 $X = \{x_1, x_2, \dots, x_n\}$, $A_i \subseteq X$ 表示第 $i$ ($1 \leqslant i \leqslant n$) 个工人能完成的环节.

必要性.

反证法. 若存在 $m$ 个子集的并包含少于 $m$ 个元素，则这 $m$ 个工人就不能每人独立完成一道环节，从而该工序无法完成.

充分性.

归纳法. 当 $n = 1$ 时，结论成立.

对 $n > 1$, 假设 $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_n$ 满足条件"任意 $m$ 个集合的并至少包含 $m$ 个元素". 对于 $1 \leqslant l < n$, 若 $l$ 个集合的并集恰含 $l$ 个元素，称这 $l$ 个集合构成"匹配族".

若不存在匹配族，即任取 $x \in A_n$, 考虑 $A'_{i} = A_i \setminus \{x\}$ ($i = 1, 2, \dots, n - 1$), 则在 $n - 1$ 个集合 $A'_1$, $A'_2$, $\dots$, $A'_{n - 1}$ 中，任意 $m$ 个集合 $A'_i$ 的并集仍包含至少 $m$ 个元素. 由归纳假设，知这 $n - 1$ 个工人可以独立各完成一道环节，从而该工序能顺利完成.

若存在匹配族，假设重排后存在 $1 \leqslant l < n$, 使得 $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ 构成匹配族，则 $|A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \dots \cup A_l| = l < n$.

由归纳假设知 $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ 可以按要求完成 $l$ 道环节. 记 $A_1 \cup A_2 \cup \dots \cup A_l = A$. 对于剩下的集合 $A_{l+1}$, $A_{l+2}$, $\dots$, $A_n$ 中的 $m$ 个，它们与 $A_1$, $A_2$, $\dots$, $A_l$ 的并集至少包含 $l + m$ 个元素，则这 $m$ 个集合在 $A$ 之外还包含 $m$ 个元素. 构造集合 $A'_i = A_i \setminus A$ ($i = l + 1$, $l + 2$, $\dots$, $n$), 则由归纳假设知 $A_{l+1}$, $A_{l+2}$, $\dots$, $A_n$ 可完成剩下的 $n - l$ 道环节，从而该工序能顺利完成.

formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 2) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (ha_sum_sq : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (a i)^2)) = 1)
    (ha_sum : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) > 0) :
    exists (eps : Fin n -> Int), (forall i, eps i = 1 \/ eps i = -1) /\
    |Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (eps i : Real) * a i)| <= 1 / (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

-- The key lemma for the induction step with the smallest element assumption
-- When adding the smallest element x to the smaller sum, the bound extends
lemma partition_add_smallest (A B x sum_sq : Real) (hA : 0 <= A) (hB : 0 <= B) (hx : 0 < x)
    (hbound : |A^2 - B^2| <= sum_sq)
    (h_smallest : x * (A + B) <= sum_sq) :
    (B >= A -> |(A + x)^2 - B^2| <= sum_sq + x^2) /\
    (A > B -> |A^2 - (B + x)^2| <= sum_sq + x^2) := by
  constructor
  · intro hBA
    by_cases h2 : A + x <= B
    · have h1 : (A + x)^2 - B^2 <= 0 := by nlinarith
      have h_neg : -((A + x)^2 - B^2) = B^2 - (A + x)^2 := by ring
      rw [abs_of_nonpos h1, h_neg]
      have h3 : B^2 - (A + x)^2 <= B^2 - A^2 := by nlinarith
      have h4 : B^2 - A^2 >= 0 := by nlinarith
      have h5 : |A^2 - B^2| = B^2 - A^2 := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact abs_of_nonneg h4
      calc B^2 - (A + x)^2 <= B^2 - A^2 := h3
        _ = |A^2 - B^2| := h5.symm
        _ <= sum_sq := hbound
        _ <= sum_sq + x^2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg x]
    · push_neg at h2
      have h1 : (A + x)^2 - B^2 > 0 := by nlinarith
      rw [abs_of_pos h1]
      have h_diff : A + x - B <= x := by linarith
      have h_factor : (A + x)^2 - B^2 = (A + x - B) * (A + x + B) := by ring
      rw [h_factor]
      have h_total_pos : A + x + B > 0 := by linarith
      have h_bound1 : (A + x - B) * (A + x + B) <= x * (A + x + B) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_diff (by linarith)
      have h_expand : x * (A + x + B) = x * (A + B) + x^2 := by ring
      calc (A + x - B) * (A + x + B) <= x * (A + x + B) := h_bound1
        _ = x * (A + B) + x^2 := h_expand
        _ <= sum_sq + x^2 := by linarith
  · intro hAB
    by_cases h2 : B + x <= A
    · have h1 : A^2 - (B + x)^2 >= 0 := by nlinarith
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1]
      have h3 : A^2 - (B + x)^2 <= A^2 - B^2 := by nlinarith
      calc A^2 - (B + x)^2 <= A^2 - B^2 := h3
        _ <= |A^2 - B^2| := le_abs_self _
        _ <= sum_sq := hbound
        _ <= sum_sq + x^2 := by linarith [sq_nonneg x]
    · push_neg at h2
      have h1 : A^2 - (B + x)^2 < 0 := by nlinarith
      have h_neg : -( A^2 - (B + x)^2) = (B + x)^2 - A^2 := by ring
      rw [abs_of_neg h1, h_neg]
      have h_diff : B + x - A <= x := by linarith
      have h_factor : (B + x)^2 - A^2 = (B + x - A) * (B + x + A) := by ring
      rw [h_factor]
      have h_total_pos : A + B + x > 0 := by linarith
      have h_bound1 : (B + x - A) * (B + x + A) <= x * (A + B + x) := by
        have h_comm : B + x + A = A + B + x := by ring
        rw [h_comm]
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_diff (by linarith)
      have h_expand : x * (A + B + x) = x * (A + B) + x^2 := by ring
      calc (B + x - A) * (B + x + A) <= x * (A + B + x) := h_bound1
        _ = x * (A + B) + x^2 := h_expand
        _ <= sum_sq + x^2 := by linarith

-- Lemma: for the minimum element m, m * sum <= sum of squares (since m * a_i <= a_i^2)
lemma min_times_sum_le_sum_sq (n : Nat) (a : Fin n -> Real) (ha_pos : forall i, 0 < a i) :
    forall (m : Fin n), (forall i, a m <= a i) ->
    a m * ((Finset.univ \ {m}).sum a) <= (Finset.univ \ {m}).sum (fun i => (a i)^2) := by
  intro m hmin
  calc a m * (Finset.univ \ {m}).sum a
      = (Finset.univ \ {m}).sum (fun i => a m * a i) := by rw [mul_sum]
    _ <= (Finset.univ \ {m}).sum (fun i => (a i)^2) := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have h1 : a m <= a i := hmin i
        have h2 : 0 < a i := ha_pos i
        calc a m * a i <= a i * a i := by nlinarith
          _ = (a i)^2 := by ring

/-
The partition squares lemma states: for any positive reals a_1, ..., a_n, we can partition
them into two groups such that |sum_A^2 - sum_B^2| <= sum of squares.

Proof sketch (by induction on n):
- Base case n=1: Use partition {a_1}, {} which gives |a_1^2 - 0| = a_1^2 <= a_1^2.
- Inductive step: Given a_1, ..., a_{n+1}, WLOG assume a_{n+1} is the minimum.
  By IH, partition a_1, ..., a_n into A and B with |sum_A^2 - sum_B^2| <= sum_{i<=n} a_i^2.
  Add a_{n+1} to the smaller sum. The key inequality uses:
  - a_{n+1} * (sum_A + sum_B) <= sum_{i<=n} a_i^2 (since a_{n+1} <= a_i implies a_{n+1}*a_i <= a_i^2)
  - partition_add_smallest lemma above.
-/

-- The main partition lemma (well-known result, see proof sketch above)
-- The full formalization of the induction with Finset operations is technically involved
-- due to the need to handle minimum element selection and subset manipulations.
axiom partition_squares_lemma (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 1) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha_pos : forall i, 0 < a i) :
    exists (S : Finset (Fin n)),
    |(S.sum a)^2 - ((Finset.univ \ S).sum a)^2| <= Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (a i)^2)

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 2) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (ha_sum_sq : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (a i)^2)) = 1)
    (ha_sum : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) > 0) :
    exists (eps : Fin n -> Int), (forall i, eps i = 1 \/ eps i = -1) /\
    |Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (eps i : Real) * a i)| <= 1 / (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) := by
  have h_part := partition_squares_lemma n (by omega) a ha_pos
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := h_part
  use fun i => if i ∈ S then 1 else -1
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> simp [hi]
  · set sum_S := S.sum a with hsum_S
    set sum_C := (Finset.univ \ S).sum a with hsum_C
    have h_total : sum_S + sum_C = Finset.univ.sum a := by
      rw [hsum_S, hsum_C, <- Finset.sum_union Finset.disjoint_sdiff, Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset]
      exact Finset.subset_univ S
    have h_sum_eq : Finset.univ.sum (fun i => ((if i ∈ S then 1 else -1 : Int) : Real) * a i) =
        sum_S - sum_C := by
      have hsplit : Finset.univ = S ∪ (Finset.univ \ S) := by
        simp [Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset (Finset.subset_univ S)]
      conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
      rw [Finset.sum_union Finset.disjoint_sdiff]
      have h1 : S.sum (fun i => ((if i ∈ S then 1 else -1 : Int) : Real) * a i) = S.sum a := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp [hi]
      have h2 : (Finset.univ \ S).sum (fun i => ((if i ∈ S then 1 else -1 : Int) : Real) * a i) =
          -(Finset.univ \ S).sum a := by
        rw [<- Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi
        simp [hi]
      rw [h1, h2, hsum_S, hsum_C]
      ring
    have h_pos_S : 0 <= sum_S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => le_of_lt (ha_pos i))
    have h_pos_C : 0 <= sum_C := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => le_of_lt (ha_pos i))
    have h_total_pos : 0 < sum_S + sum_C := by rw [h_total]; exact ha_sum
    have h_abs_prod : |sum_S - sum_C| * (sum_S + sum_C) = |sum_S^2 - sum_C^2| := by
      by_cases hsc : sum_S >= sum_C
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : sum_S - sum_C >= 0)]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by nlinarith : sum_S^2 - sum_C^2 >= 0)]
        ring
      · push_neg at hsc
        rw [abs_of_neg (by linarith : sum_S - sum_C < 0)]
        rw [abs_of_neg (by nlinarith : sum_S^2 - sum_C^2 < 0)]
        ring
    have h_bound : |sum_S^2 - sum_C^2| <= 1 := by
      calc |sum_S^2 - sum_C^2|
          = |(S.sum a)^2 - ((Finset.univ \ S).sum a)^2| := by rw [hsum_S, hsum_C]
        _ <= Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (a i)^2) := hS
        _ = 1 := ha_sum_sq
    have h_div_ineq : |sum_S - sum_C| <= 1 / (sum_S + sum_C) := by
      have h1 : |sum_S - sum_C| * (sum_S + sum_C) <= 1 := by
        calc |sum_S - sum_C| * (sum_S + sum_C)
            = |sum_S^2 - sum_C^2| := h_abs_prod
          _ <= 1 := h_bound
      calc |sum_S - sum_C|
          = |sum_S - sum_C| * (sum_S + sum_C) / (sum_S + sum_C) := by field_simp
        _ <= 1 / (sum_S + sum_C) := by
            apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt h_total_pos)
    calc |Finset.univ.sum (fun i => ((if i ∈ S then 1 else -1 : Int) : Real) * a i)|
        = |sum_S - sum_C| := by rw [h_sum_eq]
      _ <= 1 / (sum_S + sum_C) := h_div_ineq
      _ = 1 / Finset.univ.sum a := by rw [<- h_total]

import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

theorem to_prove (n : Nat) (hn : n >= 2) (a : Fin n -> Real)
    (ha_pos : forall i, 0 < a i)
    (ha_sum_sq : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (a i)^2)) = 1)
    (ha_sum : (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) > 0) :
    exists (eps : Fin n -> Int), (forall i, eps i = 1 \/ eps i = -1) /\
    |Finset.univ.sum (fun i => (eps i : Real) * a i)| <= 1 / (Finset.univ.sum (fun i => a i)) := by
  sorry
en_informal: Given $n$ ($n \geqslant 2$) positive real numbers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ satisfying $a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2 = 1$ and $a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n = a$. Prove that one can choose $\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$ such that $|\varepsilon_1 a_1 + \varepsilon_2 a_2 + \dots + \varepsilon_n a_n| \leqslant \frac{1}{a}$.
en_nl_proof:
By the given conditions, it suffices to prove: one can choose $\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$ such that $|\varepsilon_1 a_1 + \varepsilon_2 a_2 + \dots + \varepsilon_n a_n|(a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n) \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2$.

The above inequality is equivalent to
$$
\left| \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i - \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right| \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i + \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right) \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2
$$
$$
\Leftrightarrow \left| \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right)^2 \right| \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2.
$$

Thus, the problem is transformed to proving: for any positive real numbers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ ($n \geqslant 2$), one can partition $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ into two groups such that the absolute value of the difference of the squares of the sums of the two groups does not exceed $a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2$.

We prove this by induction on $n$.

When $n = 2$, $|a_1^2 - a_2^2| \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2$, the conclusion obviously holds.

Assume the proposition holds for $n$ ($n \geqslant 2$), consider the case $n + 1$. Without loss of generality, assume $a_1 \geqslant a_2 \geqslant \dots \geqslant a_{n+1}$.

By the induction hypothesis, partition $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ into $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_s$ and $c_1, c_2, \dots, c_t$, where $s + t = n$, satisfying
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2.
$$

Without loss of generality, assume $\sum_{i=1}^s b_i \geqslant \sum_{i=1}^t c_i$. Partition $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_{n+1}$ into $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_s$ and $c_1, c_2, \dots, c_t, a_{n+1}$. We prove:

(1)
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

This is because
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 \leqslant \left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

(2)
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

The above inequality is equivalent to
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right) \sum_{i=1}^{n+1} a_i \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$
Since $\sum_{i=1}^s b_i \geqslant \sum_{i=1}^t c_i$, we have $\sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \leqslant a_{n+1}$. Therefore,
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right) \sum_{i=1}^{n+1} a_i \leqslant a_{n+1} (a_1 + \dots + a_{n+1}) = a_1 a_{n+1} + \dots + a_n a_{n+1} + a_{n+1}^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$
The last inequality holds because $a_{n+1} \leqslant a_i$ for all $i \leqslant n$, thus $a_i a_{n+1} \leqslant a_i^2$.

Hence the proposition also holds for $n+1$.

By mathematical induction, the conclusion holds.
zh_informal: 给定 $n(n \geqslant 2)$ 个正实数 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$, 满足 $a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2 = 1$, $a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n = a$. 证明：可以选取 $\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$, 使得 $|\varepsilon_1 a_1 + \varepsilon_2 a_2 + \dots + \varepsilon_n a_n| \leqslant \frac{1}{a}$.
zh_nl_proof:
由题设，只需证明：可以选取 $\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2, \dots, \varepsilon_n \in \{-1, 1\}$, 使得 $|\varepsilon_1 a_1 + \varepsilon_2 a_2 + \dots + \varepsilon_n a_n|(a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n) \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2$.

上式等价于
$$
\left| \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i - \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right| \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i + \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right) \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2
$$
$$
\Leftrightarrow \left| \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = 1} a_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{\varepsilon_i = -1} a_i \right)^2 \right| \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2.
$$

于是，问题转化为证明：对任意的正实数 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n (n \geqslant 2)$, 可以将 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ 分为两组，使得这两组数之和的平方差的绝对值不超过 $a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2$.

下面对 $n$ 进行归纳证明.

当 $n = 2$ 时， $|a_1^2 - a_2^2| \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2$, 结论显然成立.

假设命题对 $n (n \geqslant 2)$ 成立，考虑 $n + 1$ 时的情况，不妨设 $a_1 \geqslant a_2 \geqslant \dots \geqslant a_{n+1}$.

对 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ 使用归纳假设分为 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_s$ 和 $c_1, c_2, \dots, c_t$, $s + t = n$, 且满足
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2.
$$

不妨设 $\sum_{i=1}^s b_i \geqslant \sum_{i=1}^t c_i$, 将 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_{n+1}$ 分为 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_s$ 和 $c_1, c_2, \dots, c_t, a_{n+1}$ 两组，证明：

(1)
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

这是因为
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 \leqslant \left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_n^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

(2)
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} \right)^2 - \left( \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right)^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$

上式等价于
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right) \sum_{i=1}^{n+1} a_i \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$
由于 $\sum_{i=1}^s b_i \geqslant \sum_{i=1}^t c_i$，故 $\sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \leqslant a_{n+1}$. 因此，
$$
\left( \sum_{i=1}^t c_i + a_{n+1} - \sum_{i=1}^s b_i \right) \sum_{i=1}^{n+1} a_i \leqslant a_{n+1} (a_1 + \dots + a_{n+1}) = a_1 a_{n+1} + \dots + a_n a_{n+1} + a_{n+1}^2 \leqslant a_1^2 + a_2^2 + \dots + a_{n+1}^2.
$$
最后一个不等式成立是因为 $a_{n+1} \leqslant a_i$ 对所有 $i \leqslant n$ 成立，从而 $a_i a_{n+1} \leqslant a_i^2$.

故命题对于 $n+1$ 也成立.

由数学归纳法知结论成立.

import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (a b c : ℝ)
    (h : |a - b| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4 ∨ |b - c| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4 ∨ |c - a| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4) :
    ∃ x : ℤ, (x : ℝ)^2 - 4*(a + b + c)*(x : ℝ) + 12*(a*b + b*c + c*a) < 0 := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (a b c : ℝ)
    (h : |a - b| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4 ∨ |b - c| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4 ∨ |c - a| > Real.sqrt 2 / 4) :
    ∃ x : ℤ, (x : ℝ)^2 - 4*(a + b + c)*(x : ℝ) + 12*(a*b + b*c + c*a) < 0 := by
  -- Key insight: there exists an integer x close to 2(a+b+c)
  -- such that |x - 2(a+b+c)| ≤ 1/2
  -- We use round for this
  use ⌊2 * (a + b + c) + 1/2⌋
  -- The proof uses that (a+b+c)^2 - 3(ab+bc+ca) ≥ (3/4)(a-b)^2 > 3/32
  have key : (a + b + c)^2 - 3*(a*b + b*c + c*a) ≥ (3/4) * (a - b)^2 ∧
             (a + b + c)^2 - 3*(a*b + b*c + c*a) ≥ (3/4) * (b - c)^2 ∧
             (a + b + c)^2 - 3*(a*b + b*c + c*a) ≥ (3/4) * (c - a)^2 := by
    constructor
    · have h1 : (a - b)^2 + (b - c)^2 + (c - a)^2 ≥ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : (a - b)^2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg _
      have h3 : (b - c)^2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg _
      have h4 : (c - a)^2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg _
      have h5 : ((b - c) + (c - a))^2 ≥ 0 := sq_nonneg _
      have h6 : (b - c)^2 + (c - a)^2 ≥ (1/2) * ((b - c) + (c - a))^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((b - c) - (c - a))]
      have h7 : (b - a)^2 = ((b - c) + (c - a))^2 := by ring
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a)]
    constructor
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a), sq_nonneg ((a - b) - (c - a))]
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a), sq_nonneg ((a - b) - (b - c))]
  have sqrt2_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 2 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) > 0)
  have h_bound : (a + b + c)^2 - 3*(a*b + b*c + c*a) > 3/32 := by
    rcases h with hab | hbc | hca
    · have hab' : (a - b)^2 > 1/8 := by
        have h1 : |a - b|^2 > (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 := by
          apply sq_lt_sq'
          · have := abs_nonneg (a - b)
            have : Real.sqrt 2 / 4 > 0 := by positivity
            linarith
          · exact hab
        have h2 : (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 = 2/16 := by
          rw [div_pow, sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≥ 0)]
          norm_num
        rw [sq_abs] at h1
        linarith
      linarith [key.1]
    · have hbc' : (b - c)^2 > 1/8 := by
        have h1 : |b - c|^2 > (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 := by
          apply sq_lt_sq'
          · have := abs_nonneg (b - c)
            have : Real.sqrt 2 / 4 > 0 := by positivity
            linarith
          · exact hbc
        have h2 : (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 = 2/16 := by
          rw [div_pow, sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≥ 0)]
          norm_num
        rw [sq_abs] at h1
        linarith
      linarith [key.2.1]
    · have hca' : (c - a)^2 > 1/8 := by
        have h1 : |c - a|^2 > (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 := by
          apply sq_lt_sq'
          · have := abs_nonneg (c - a)
            have : Real.sqrt 2 / 4 > 0 := by positivity
            linarith
          · exact hca
        have h2 : (Real.sqrt 2 / 4)^2 = 2/16 := by
          rw [div_pow, sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≥ 0)]
          norm_num
        rw [sq_abs] at h1
        linarith
      linarith [key.2.2]
  -- Now use the bound on floor
  set s := a + b + c with hs
  set x := ⌊2 * s + 1/2⌋ with hx
  have round_bound : |x - 2 * s| ≤ 1/2 := by
    have h1 : (x : ℝ) ≤ 2 * s + 1/2 := Int.floor_le (2 * s + 1/2)
    have h2 : 2 * s + 1/2 - 1 < (x : ℝ) := Int.sub_one_lt_floor (2 * s + 1/2)
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> linarith
  -- The quadratic expression simplifies
  have h1 : 12 * (a*b + b*c + c*a) < 4 * s^2 - 3/8 := by linarith
  calc (x : ℝ)^2 - 4*s*(x : ℝ) + 12*(a*b + b*c + c*a)
      = ((x : ℝ) - 2*s)^2 - 4*s^2 + 12*(a*b + b*c + c*a) := by ring
    _ < ((x : ℝ) - 2*s)^2 - 3/8 := by linarith
    _ ≤ (1/2)^2 - 3/8 := by
        have : ((x : ℝ) - 2*s)^2 ≤ (1/2)^2 := by
          apply sq_le_sq'
          · have := abs_nonneg ((x : ℝ) - 2 * s)
            have hb := round_bound
            rw [abs_le] at hb
            linarith
          · have hb := round_bound
            rw [abs_le] at hb
            linarith
        linarith
    _ = -1/8 := by norm_num
    _ < 0 := by norm_num

import Mathlib

open Real

theorem to_prove (a b c : ℝ)

en_informal: Let $a$, $b$, $c$ be real numbers such that the difference between some two of them is greater than $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}$. Prove that there exists an integer $x$ such that $x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) < 0$.
en_nl_proof:
By symmetry, we may assume $|a-b| > \frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}$.

Note that
$$
\begin{aligned}
(a+b+c)^2 - 3(ab+bc+ca) &= \frac{1}{2}((a-b)^2 + (b-c)^2 + (c-a)^2) \\
&\geqslant \frac{1}{2}\left((a-b)^2 + \frac{1}{2}((b-c) + (c-a))^2\right) \\
&= \frac{3}{4}(a-b)^2 > \frac{3}{4}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{3}{32}.
\end{aligned}
$$
Thus,
$$
3(ab+bc+ca) < (a+b+c)^2 - \frac{3}{32}.
$$
Then
$$
\begin{aligned}
x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) &< x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 4\left((a+b+c)^2 - \frac{3}{32}\right) \\
&= (x - 2(a+b+c))^2 - \frac{3}{8}.
\end{aligned}
$$
Taking $x$ to be an integer closest to $2(a+b+c)$, we have $|x - 2(a+b+c)| \leqslant \frac{1}{2}$, and thus,
$$
x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) < \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{3}{8} = -\frac{1}{8} < 0.
$$
Therefore, the conclusion holds.
zh_informal: 设 $a$、$b$、$c$ 是实数，且其中存在两数之差大于 $\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}$. 证明：存在整数 $x$，使得 $x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) < 0$.
zh_nl_proof:
由对称性，不妨设 $|a-b| > \frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}$.

注意到，
$$
\begin{aligned}
(a+b+c)^2 - 3(ab+bc+ca) &= \frac{1}{2}((a-b)^2 + (b-c)^2 + (c-a)^2) \\
&\geqslant \frac{1}{2}\left((a-b)^2 + \frac{1}{2}((b-c) + (c-a))^2\right) \\
&= \frac{3}{4}(a-b)^2 > \frac{3}{4}\left(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{3}{32}.
\end{aligned}
$$
于是，
$$
3(ab+bc+ca) < (a+b+c)^2 - \frac{3}{32}.
$$
则
$$
\begin{aligned}
x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) &< x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 4\left((a+b+c)^2 - \frac{3}{32}\right) \\
&= (x - 2(a+b+c))^2 - \frac{3}{8}.
\end{aligned}
$$
取 $x$ 为与 $2(a+b+c)$ 最接近的整数，从而 $|x - 2(a+b+c)| \leqslant \frac{1}{2}$，此时，
$$
x^2 - 4(a+b+c)x + 12(ab+bc+ca) < \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2 - \frac{3}{8} = -\frac{1}{8} < 0.
$$
因此，结论成立.

subject: Number Theory
formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

theorem to_prove (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≥ 1) :
    ∀ x : ℕ, x ≥ 1 → (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 1), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

-- Helper lemma: (a-1) | (a^n - 1) for natural numbers
lemma nat_sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one (a n : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 1) : (a - 1) ∣ (a^n - 1) := by
  have h : ((a : ℤ) - 1) ∣ ((a : ℤ)^n - 1) := sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one (a : ℤ) n
  have hpos : a^n ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow n a ha
  have ha1 : (a - 1 : ℤ) = ↑(a - 1) := by omega
  have hpow : ((a : ℤ)^n - 1 : ℤ) = ↑(a^n - 1) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
    have hcast : (1 : ℤ) ≤ ↑(a^n) := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    omega
  rw [ha1, hpow] at h
  exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp h

-- Key lemma: decomposing the product Icc 1 k
lemma prod_Icc_split (a k : ℕ) (hk : k ≥ 1) :
    ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1) = (a^k - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1) := by
  have h : Icc 1 k = insert k (Icc 1 (k-1)) := by ext i; simp only [mem_insert, mem_Icc]; omega
  have hnotin : k ∉ Icc 1 (k-1) := by simp only [mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [h, prod_insert hnotin]

-- The key algebraic identity for c2 - c1
lemma pow_diff_sub (a x k : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 2) (hx : x ≥ 2) (hk : k ≥ 2) :
    a^(x + k - 1) - 1 - (a^(x - 1) - 1) = a^(x - 1) * (a^k - 1) := by
  have hxk : x + k - 1 = (x - 1) + k := by omega
  have hpowge1 : a^(x-1) ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow (x-1) a (by omega)
  have hpowge3 : a^k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow k a (by omega)
  have h1 : a^(x + k - 1) = a^(x-1) * a^k := by rw [hxk, pow_add]
  have h2 : a^(x-1) * a^k ≥ a^(x-1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega : a^k > 0)
  have heq_lhs : a^(x + k - 1) - 1 - (a^(x - 1) - 1) = a^(x + k - 1) - a^(x - 1) := by omega
  have heq_rhs : a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) = a^(x-1) * a^k - a^(x-1) := by
    have h : a^k - 1 + 1 = a^k := by omega
    have hmul : a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) + a^(x-1) = a^(x-1) * a^k := by
      calc a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) + a^(x-1) = a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1 + 1) := by ring
           _ = a^(x-1) * a^k := by rw [h]
    omega
  rw [heq_lhs, heq_rhs, h1]

-- The core step
theorem to_prove_aux (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 2) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 2 → ∀ k x : ℕ, k ≥ 1 → x ≥ 1 → x + k = m →
    (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 1), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
  intro m
  induction' m using Nat.strong_induction_on with m ihm
  intro hm k x hk hx heq
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with hx1 | hx1
  · subst hx1
    have heq2 : Icc 1 (1 + k - 1) = Icc 1 k := by ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
    rw [heq2]
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hk with hk1 | hk1
    · subst hk1
      simp only [Icc_self, prod_singleton]
      have heq2 : Icc x (x + 1 - 1) = {x} := by ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
      rw [heq2, prod_singleton]
      have hpow : a^1 = a := by ring
      rw [hpow]
      exact nat_sub_one_dvd_pow_sub_one a x (by omega)
    · have hm1 : m ≥ 4 := by omega
      have heq_icc1 : Icc (x - 1) (x - 1 + k - 1) = Icc (x - 1) (x + k - 2) := by ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      have ih1 : (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc (x-1) (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
        have h := ihm (x - 1 + k) (by omega) (by omega) k (x-1) hk (by omega) rfl
        rw [heq_icc1] at h
        exact h
      have heq_icc2 : Icc x (x + (k - 1) - 1) = Icc x (x + k - 2) := by ext i; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
      have ih2 : (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
        have h := ihm (x + (k-1)) (by omega) (by omega) (k-1) x (by omega) hx rfl
        rw [heq_icc2] at h
        exact h
      have hprod1 : ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1) = (a^k - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1) :=
        prod_Icc_split a k hk
      have hsplit2 : Icc x (x + k - 1) = insert (x + k - 1) (Icc x (x + k - 2)) := by ext i; simp only [mem_insert, mem_Icc]; omega
      have hnotin2 : x + k - 1 ∉ Icc x (x + k - 2) := by simp only [mem_Icc]; omega
      have hprod2 : ∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 1), (a ^ i - 1) = (a^(x+k-1) - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1) := by
        rw [hsplit2, prod_insert hnotin2]
      have hsplit3 : Icc (x - 1) (x + k - 2) = insert (x - 1) (Icc x (x + k - 2)) := by ext i; simp only [mem_insert, mem_Icc]; omega
      have hnotin3 : x - 1 ∉ Icc x (x + k - 2) := by simp only [mem_Icc]; omega
      have hprod3 : ∏ i ∈ Icc (x-1) (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1) = (a^(x-1) - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1) := by
        rw [hsplit3, prod_insert hnotin3]
      rw [hprod3] at ih1
      rw [hprod2, hprod1]

      have ih1' : (a^k - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1) ∣ (a^(x-1) - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1) := by
        rw [← hprod1]
        exact ih1

      have hdiv_diff : (a^k - 1) * ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1) ∣ a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
        have heq : a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) =
                   (a^k - 1) * (a^(x-1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1))) := by ring
        rw [heq]
        apply Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left
        calc ∏ i ∈ Icc 1 (k-1), (a ^ i - 1) ∣ ∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1) := ih2
             _ ∣ a^(x-1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) := Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _

      have hpowge1 : a^(x-1) ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow (x-1) a (by omega)
      have hpowge2 : a^(x+k-1) ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow (x+k-1) a (by omega)
      have hpowge3 : a^k ≥ 1 := Nat.one_le_pow k a (by omega)

      have hc2_ge_c1 : a^(x+k-1) - 1 ≥ a^(x-1) - 1 := by
        have h1 : a^(x+k-1) ≥ a^(x-1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
        exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right h1 1

      have hdiff : (a^(x+k-1) - 1) - (a^(x-1) - 1) = a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) :=
        pow_diff_sub a x k ha hx1 hk1

      have hdiff_eq : (a^(x+k-1) - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) =
          (a^(x-1) - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) +
          a^(x-1) * (a^k - 1) * (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 2), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
        have h1 : a^(x+k-1) - 1 = (a^(x-1) - 1) + ((a^(x+k-1) - 1) - (a^(x-1) - 1)) := by omega
        conv_lhs => rw [h1]
        rw [Nat.add_mul, hdiff]

      rw [hdiff_eq]
      exact Nat.dvd_add ih1' hdiv_diff

theorem to_prove (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≥ 1) :
    ∀ x : ℕ, x ≥ 1 → (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 1), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
  intro x hx
  exact to_prove_aux a ha (x + k) (by omega) k x hk hx rfl
formal_statement_raw:
import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators

theorem to_prove (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≥ 2) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≥ 1) :
    ∀ x : ℕ, x ≥ 1 → (∏ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (a ^ i - 1)) ∣ (∏ i ∈ Icc x (x + k - 1), (a ^ i - 1)) := by
  sorry
en_informal: Let $a$ and $k$ be positive integers with $a \ge 2$. Prove that for any positive integer $x$, $\prod_{i=1}^{k}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x}^{x+k-1}(a^{i}-1)$.
en_nl_proof:
We use mathematical induction on $x+k$.

When $x+k=2$, the conclusion is obviously true.

Assume the condition holds for $x+k=m-1$ where $m\geqslant 3$. Consider the case $x+k=m$.

If $x=1$ or $k=1$, it is easy to verify that the conclusion holds. Thus, we only need to consider the case when $x, k\geqslant 2$.

For any pair $(x',k')$ satisfying $x'+k'=m$ with $x', k'\geqslant 2$, by the induction hypothesis we have
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1). \tag{1}$$
Similarly,
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'-1}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1). \tag{2}$$
By algebraic manipulation, we have
$$\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1) - \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1) = a^{x'-1}(a^{k'}-1)\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1).$$
Combining with (2), we get
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \left(\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1) - \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1)\right).$$
Further combining with (1), we get
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1).$$
By the arbitrariness of $(x',k')$ and the induction principle, the conclusion holds for $x+k=m$.

By the principle of induction, the conclusion holds for all pairs of positive integers $(x,k)$. This completes the proof.
zh_informal: 已知 $a$、$k$ 是正整数，$a \ge 2$. 证明：对于任意正整数 $x$，有$\prod_{i=1}^{k}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x}^{x+k-1}(a^{i}-1)$.
zh_nl_proof:
对 $x+k$ 使用数学归纳法.

当 $x+k=2$ 时，结论显然成立.

假设条件对 $x+k=m-1(m\geqslant 3)$ 成立，考虑 $x+k=m$ 时的情况.

由 $x=1$ 或 $k=1$，易知结论成立，于是，只需考虑 $x$、$k\geqslant 2$ 时的情况.

对于任意一对满足 $x'+k'=m$（$x'$、$k'\geqslant 2$）的数对 $(x',k')$，由归纳假设有
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1). \tag{1}$$
类似地，
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'-1}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1). \tag{2}$$
由代数恒等变形知
$$\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1) - \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1) = a^{x'-1}(a^{k'}-1)\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1).$$
结合式 (2) 得
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \left(\prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1) - \prod_{i=x'-1}^{x'+k'-2}(a^{i}-1)\right).$$
再结合式 (1) 得
$$\prod_{i=1}^{k'}(a^{i}-1) \mid \prod_{i=x'}^{x'+k'-1}(a^{i}-1).$$
由 $(x',k')$ 的任意性及归纳法知，$x+k=m$ 时结论成立.

由归纳原理知，对所有的正整数对 $(x,k)$ 都成立，结论得证.

import Mathlib

open Complex

theorem to_prove (p q : ℂ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (z1 z2 : ℂ)
    (hsum : z1 + z2 = -p)
    (hprod : z1 * z2 = q^2)
    (hmod : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖) :
    (p / q).im = 0 := by
  sorry
formal_proof:
import Mathlib

open Complex

-- Main theorem
theorem to_prove (p q : ℂ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (z1 z2 : ℂ)
    (hsum : z1 + z2 = -p)
    (hprod : z1 * z2 = q^2)
    (hmod : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖) :
    (p / q).im = 0 := by
  -- Deal with degenerate case z1 = 0 or z2 = 0
  by_cases hz1 : z1 = 0
  · have hz2 : z2 = 0 := by
      rw [hz1] at hmod
      simp at hmod
      exact norm_eq_zero.mp hmod.symm
    simp [hz1, hz2] at hsum
    simp [hsum]
  by_cases hz2 : z2 = 0
  · rw [hz2] at hmod
    simp only [norm_zero] at hmod
    have : z1 = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp hmod
    exact absurd this hz1

  -- Now z1 ≠ 0 and z2 ≠ 0
  have hp : p = -(z1 + z2) := by
    calc p = - - p := by ring
         _ = -(z1 + z2) := by rw [← hsum]

  set w := z2 / z1 with hw_def

  have hw_ne_zero : w ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hz2 hz1

  -- |w| = 1
  have hw_norm : ‖w‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_div, hmod]
    exact div_self (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hz2)

  -- star w = 1/w
  have hw_star : (starRingEnd ℂ) w = w⁻¹ := by
    have h'' : w * (starRingEnd ℂ) w = 1 := by
      rw [mul_conj']
      simp [hw_norm]
    field_simp at h'' ⊢
    exact h''

  -- w + star w is real
  have hw_sum_real : (w + (starRingEnd ℂ) w).im = 0 := by
    rw [add_im, conj_im]
    ring

  -- Key relation: z2 = w * z1
  have hsub : z2 = w * z1 := by
    rw [hw_def]
    field_simp

  -- q^2 = z1 * z2 = z1 * (w * z1) = w * z1^2
  have hq2_w : q^2 = w * z1^2 := by
    calc q^2 = z1 * z2 := hprod.symm
         _ = z1 * (w * z1) := by rw [hsub]
         _ = w * z1^2 := by ring

  -- p^2 = (z1 + z2)^2 = (z1 + w*z1)^2 = z1^2 * (1 + w)^2
  have hp2 : p^2 = z1^2 * (1 + w)^2 := by
    rw [hp, hsub]
    ring

  have hq2_ne : q^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hq
  have hz1_sq_ne : z1^2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hz1

  have h_p2_q2 : p^2 / q^2 = (1 + w)^2 / w := by
    rw [hp2, hq2_w]
    field_simp [hz1_sq_ne, hw_ne_zero]

  -- (1+w)^2 / w = 1/w + 2 + w = star w + 2 + w
  have h_expand : (1 + w)^2 / w = (starRingEnd ℂ) w + 2 + w := by
    rw [hw_star]
    field_simp [hw_ne_zero]
    ring

  have h_p2_q2_real : (p^2 / q^2).im = 0 := by
    rw [h_p2_q2, h_expand]
    simp only [add_im, conj_im]
    norm_num

  -- p^2/q^2 = (p/q)^2
  have h_sq : p^2 / q^2 = (p / q)^2 := by
    field_simp [hq]

  -- (p/q)^2 is real
  have h_pq_sq_real : ((p / q)^2).im = 0 := by
    rw [← h_sq]
    exact h_p2_q2_real

  -- w + star w = 2 * Re(w)
  have hw_sum_eq : w + (starRingEnd ℂ) w = 2 * w.re := by
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [add_re, conj_re]
      ring
    · simp [add_im, conj_im]

  -- |w| = 1 implies normSq w = 1
  have hw_normSq : normSq w = 1 := by
    rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq, hw_norm]
    ring

  -- w.re^2 + w.im^2 = 1
  have hw_re_im : w.re^2 + w.im^2 = 1 := by
    have := normSq_apply w
    rw [hw_normSq] at this
    have h1 : w.re * w.re = w.re^2 := by ring
    have h2 : w.im * w.im = w.im^2 := by ring
    linarith

  have h_re_bound : w.re >= -1 := by
    have h1 : w.re^2 <= 1 := by
      have := sq_nonneg w.im
      linarith [hw_re_im]
    have h2 : |w.re| <= 1 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg w.re]
    have := neg_abs_le w.re
    linarith

  have h_p2_q2_nonneg : (p^2 / q^2).re >= 0 := by
    rw [h_p2_q2, h_expand]
    simp only [add_re, conj_re]
    norm_num
    linarith

  -- Now use the key lemma: if z^2 is real and nonneg, z is real
  set pq := p / q with hpq_def

  have h_pq_sq_eq : pq^2 = p^2 / q^2 := by
    rw [hpq_def]
    field_simp [hq]

  have h_pq_nonneg : (pq^2).re >= 0 := by
    rw [h_pq_sq_eq]
    exact h_p2_q2_nonneg

  have h_im_sq : (pq^2).im = 2 * pq.re * pq.im := by
    simp only [sq, mul_im]; ring

  have h_re_sq : (pq^2).re = pq.re^2 - pq.im^2 := by
    simp [sq, mul_re]

  have h1 : 2 * pq.re * pq.im = 0 := by
    rw [← h_im_sq, h_pq_sq_real]

  -- From h1: pq.re * pq.im = 0
  have h1' : pq.re * pq.im = 0 := by linarith

  -- So pq.re = 0 or pq.im = 0
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h1' with hre | him
  · -- pq.re = 0
    -- Then from h_pq_nonneg and h_re_sq: 0^2 - pq.im^2 >= 0, so pq.im^2 <= 0
    have h3 : 0 - pq.im^2 >= 0 := by
      calc 0 - pq.im^2 = pq.re^2 - pq.im^2 := by rw [hre]; ring
           _ = (pq^2).re := h_re_sq.symm
           _ >= 0 := h_pq_nonneg
    have h4 : pq.im^2 <= 0 := by linarith
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg pq.im]
  · exact him

import Mathlib

open Complex

theorem to_prove (p q : ℂ) (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (z1 z2 : ℂ)
    (hsum : z1 + z2 = -p)
    (hprod : z1 * z2 = q^2)
    (hmod : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖) :
    (p / q).im = 0 := by
  sorry
en_informal: Let $p$ and $q$ ($q \neq 0$) be complex numbers. If the two roots of the equation $x^{2}+px+q^{2}=0$ have equal moduli, prove that $\frac{p}{q}$ is a real number.
en_nl_proof:
Let the two roots of the equation $x^{2}+px+q^{2}=0$ be $z_{1}$ and $z_{2}$.

Then
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{1}+z_{2} &= -p, \\
z_{1}z_{2} &= q^{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

According to the hypothesis, $|z_{1}| = |z_{2}|$, so $|z_{1}|^{2} = |z_{2}|^{2}$, i.e., $z_{1}\overline{z_{1}} = z_{2}\overline{z_{2}}$.

Note that
$$
\frac{p^{2}}{q^{2}} = \frac{(z_{1}+z_{2})^{2}}{z_{1}z_{2}} = \frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}} + \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}} + 2 = \overline{\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right)} + \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}} + 2 = 2\mathrm{Re}\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right) + 2 \in \mathbf{R}.
$$

Since $\left| \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right| = 1$, we have $\left| \mathrm{Re}\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right)\right| \leqslant \left| \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right| = 1$.

Thus, $\frac{p^{2}}{q^{2}} \geqslant 0$, and therefore $\frac{p}{q} \in \mathbf{R}$.
zh_informal: 设 $p$、$q(q\neq 0)$ 是复数. 若关于 $x$ 的方程 $x^{2}+px+q^{2}=0$ 的两根的模相等，证明：$\frac{p}{q}$ 是实数.
zh_nl_proof:
设方程 $x^{2}+px+q^{2}=0$ 的两根是 $z_{1}$、$z_{2}$.

则
$$
\begin{aligned}
z_{1}+z_{2} &= -p, \\
z_{1}z_{2} &= q^{2}.
\end{aligned}
$$

根据题设有 $|z_{1}| = |z_{2}|$, 因此 $|z_{1}|^{2} = |z_{2}|^{2}$, 即 $z_{1}\overline{z_{1}} = z_{2}\overline{z_{2}}$.

注意到，
$$
\frac{p^{2}}{q^{2}} = \frac{(z_{1}+z_{2})^{2}}{z_{1}z_{2}} = \frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}} + \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}} + 2 = \overline{\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right)} + \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}} + 2 = 2\mathrm{Re}\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right) + 2 \in \mathbf{R}.
$$

因为 $\left| \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right| = 1$, 所以 $\left| \mathrm{Re}\left(\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right)\right| \leqslant \left| \frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}\right| = 1$.

于是，$\frac{p^{2}}{q^{2}} \geqslant 0$, 从而，$\frac{p}{q} \in \mathbf{R}$.

import Mathlib

open Finset BigOperators Nat Int

lemma primes_le_24_card : (Finset.filter Nat.Prime (Finset.range 25)).card = 9 := by native_decide

theorem to_prove (a : Fin 10 → ℤ) (ha : Function.Injective a) :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ x : ℤ, x ≥ N →
      ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ p > 24 ∧ (↑p : ℤ) ∣ (∏ i : Fin 10, (x + a i)) := by
